job_description:
# Job Description: Production Manager – Jewellery Industry

\*\*Position:\*\* Production Manager

\*\*Industry:\*\* Jewellery Manufacturing

\*\*Experience:\*\* 6–7 Years

\*\*Salary:\*\* ₹50,000–₹1,00,000 per month

\*\*Job Location:\*\* Andheri East, Mumbai – 400096

\*\*Employment Type:\*\* Full-Time

\*\*Office Timings\*\*. - 9 AM to 6:15 PM

### Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Production Manager with 6–7 years of experience in the jewellery manufacturing industry. The candidate will be responsible for managing the overall jewellery production process, supervising production teams, ensuring product quality, monitoring production timelines, and maintaining operational efficiency.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of jewellery manufacturing processes, workforce management, production planning, quality control, and inventory coordination.

### Key Responsibilities

- Manage and supervise daily jewellery manufacturing and production activities.

- Plan, organize, and monitor production schedules to ensure timely completion of orders.

- Coordinate with design, CAD, manufacturing, finishing, and quality control teams.

- Monitor the entire production process, from raw materials to finished jewellery products.

- Ensure jewellery products meet the required quality standards and specifications.

- Supervise production staff, assign responsibilities, and monitor team performance.

- Identify production delays, technical issues, and operational challenges and take corrective action.

- Maintain production records, reports, and daily work progress.

- Monitor raw material usage, wastage, and inventory levels.

- Ensure efficient utilization of manpower, machinery, tools, and other resources.

- Coordinate with vendors and suppliers whenever required.

- Implement measures to improve production efficiency, reduce wastage, and control manufacturing costs.

- Ensure compliance with workplace safety standards and company policies.

- Handle customer-specific production requirements and ensure orders are completed within deadlines.

### Required Skills & Qualifications

- 6–7 years of experience in jewellery manufacturing or production management.

- Strong knowledge of jewellery manufacturing processes and techniques.

- Experience in handling and managing production teams.

- Good understanding of gold, diamond, gemstone, and other jewellery manufacturing processes.

- Knowledge of production planning, scheduling, and workflow management.

- Strong understanding of quality control and jewellery finishing standards.

- Ability to manage production targets and meet delivery deadlines.

- Knowledge of inventory management and material utilization.

- Good leadership, team management, and problem-solving skills.

- Strong coordination and communication abilities.

- Basic computer knowledge and experience in maintaining production reports.

- Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple production activities.

### Salary & Benefits

- \*\*Salary:\*\* ₹50,000–₹1,00,000 per month, depending on experience, skills, and industry knowledge.

- Other benefits as per company policy.

### Candidate Requirements

- Candidates must have relevant experience in the jewellery manufacturing industry.

- Experience in handling jewellery production teams and managing end-to-end production activities is preferred.

- Candidates should have strong knowledge of production planning, quality control, and manufacturing operations.

- Ability to manage production targets and ensure timely delivery of orders.

### How to Apply

Interested candidates with relevant experience in jewellery production management are encouraged to apply with their updated resume. Candidates with strong leadership skills and hands-on experience in jewellery manufacturing will be preferred.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹100,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Product Manager – Digital Payments & Financial Services**

**Company: AvenuesAI Limited**

**Location:** Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Department:** Product Management

**Experience:** 8–12 years

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Reporting To:** Head of Product / Business Head / Senior Management

**Role Overview**

**AvenuesAI Limited** is looking for an experienced and result-oriented Product Manager to manage and drive the development, enhancement and performance of its digital payment products and financial technology solutions.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in payment processing, digital payment ecosystems, prepaid payment instruments (PPI), banking and financial integrations, regulatory compliance and product operations.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the product lifecycle, identifying business opportunities, coordinating with technology and business teams, implementing product enhancements and ensuring seamless product delivery in line with business objectives, regulatory requirements and customer expectations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management**

* + Define and execute product strategies aligned with the company's business goals.
  + Manage the complete product lifecycle, from conceptualisation and requirement gathering to development, launch and post-launch performance monitoring.
  + Identify opportunities for new product development, enhancements and business expansion.
  + Prepare product roadmaps, business requirement documents (BRDs), product requirement documents (PRDs) and functional specifications.
  + Monitor product performance and recommend improvements based on business and customer feedback.

**2. Digital Payments & Financial Integrations**

* + Manage and drive payment products and integrations across BBPS, PPI and other applicable payment channels.
  + Coordinate with banks, NPCI, payment aggregators, technology partners and other financial institutions for product integrations.
  + Oversee payment workflows, transaction processing, settlement, reconciliation and exception management.
  + Ensure smooth implementation, testing and deployment of new payment features and integrations.
  + Identify and resolve product-related operational challenges affecting transaction success rates and customer experience.

**3. Product Development & Technology Coordination**

* + Work closely with technology, engineering, QA and operations teams to translate business requirements into product specifications.
  + Define product priorities, development milestones and implementation timelines.
  + Coordinate UAT, functional testing, integration testing and product acceptance.
  + Track product development progress and ensure timely delivery.
  + Identify system gaps, process bottlenecks and opportunities for automation.

**4. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management**

* + Ensure product processes and functionalities are aligned with applicable RBI guidelines, NPCI regulations and other relevant regulatory requirements.
  + Work closely with compliance, risk and legal teams to implement regulatory changes.
  + Monitor transaction risks, fraud indicators, operational exceptions and control mechanisms.
  + Support internal, external and regulatory audits by maintaining appropriate product documentation and operational records.
  + Ensure appropriate controls are incorporated into product design and delivery.

**5. Business & Operational Performance**

* + Define and monitor product KPIs, including transaction success rates, transaction volumes, revenue, active users, turnaround time and customer complaints.
  + Analyse product performance and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and profitability.
  + Drive initiatives to improve customer and merchant experience.
  + Work with sales and business development teams to support product adoption, partner onboarding and revenue growth.
  + Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) for product-related processes.

**6. Stakeholder & Team Management**

* + Act as the primary coordination point between business, technology, operations, compliance and external partners.
  + Manage relationships with banks, payment networks, vendors and technology service providers.
  + Lead product review meetings and provide regular updates to senior management.
  + Guide and mentor team members involved in product operations and implementation.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* + Graduate degree in Business Administration, Finance, Commerce, Technology or a related discipline.
  + 8–12 years of experience in fintech, digital payments, banking, financial services or payment operations.
  + Strong understanding of digital payment systems, payment processing and settlement mechanisms.
  + Practical experience in UPI, IMPS, PPI and other payment integrations.
  + Experience in product onboarding, implementation, product enhancement and operational management.
  + Good understanding of RBI guidelines, NPCI processes, compliance requirements and risk management.
  + Proven experience working with technology, operations, business and compliance teams.

**Required Skills**

* + Product lifecycle and roadmap management
  + Digital payment ecosystem knowledge
  + Payment processing and reconciliation
  + UPI, IMPS, PPI and banking integrations
  + BRD, PRD and functional requirement documentation
  + UAT and product implementation
  + RBI and NPCI regulatory understanding
  + Risk management and fraud monitoring
  + Data analysis and KPI monitoring
  + Stakeholder and vendor management
  + Team leadership and problem-solving
  + Strong communication and decision-making skills

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated on the basis of:

* + Successful and timely delivery of product launches and enhancements.
  + Improvement in transaction success rates and payment processing efficiency.
  + Reduction in transaction failures, reconciliation issues and operational exceptions.
  + Timely completion of banking, NPCI and third-party integrations.
  + Compliance with applicable regulatory and internal control requirements.
  + Improvement in product adoption, customer experience and business performance.
  + Effective coordination with internal teams and external stakeholders.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

The preferred candidate should be a hands-on fintech professional with a strong understanding of the Indian digital payments ecosystem. The candidate should be capable of bridging the gap between business requirements and technology execution, while ensuring operational efficiency, regulatory compliance and sustainable product growth.

Experience in PPI services, UPI/IMPS integrations, payment settlements, banking partnerships and payment product implementation will be an added advantage.

job_description:
Role Overview

As an AI Agent Product Manager at SquadStack.ai you’ll own each stage of the AI Agent building and deployment process for the largest consumer enterprises.

You’ll work directly with VP and C-level executives to shape their AI roadmap, write and test prompt logic for high-impact use cases, and collaborate with engineering to design new product features.

This is a role for someone who thrives on diving deep into complex business problems, crafting elegant AI-driven solutions, and scaling them to millions of users.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the deployment of SquadStack.ai's Voice AI Agents for some of the largest consumer enterprises globally, ensuring AI agents become mission-critical to how millions of customers are engaged.

Design and optimize enterprise-grade agents by mapping business workflows, writing and testing prompt logic, and collaborating with engineering to deliver precise, scalable solutions that handle thousands of conversations daily.

Engage deeply with customers, from discovering requirements and demonstrating solutions, to addressing technical challenges, and tailoring agents to their business processes.

Act as a trusted partner to VP and C-level executives, guiding their AI roadmap, aligning deployments with strategic goals, and ensuring measurable impact on revenue, efficiency, and customer experience.

Own a portfolio of enterprise deployments end-to-end, driving adoption, expansion, and long-term success by partnering closely with internal teams and customer stakeholders.

Run high-velocity feedback loops into Product and Engineering, channeling real-world insights to shape the roadmap, resolve friction, and accelerate adoption at scale.

Requirements

2–5 years of relevant experience in AI Implementation, Product Management, Strategy Consulting, or Solutions Engineering ideally in AI-native companies or adjacent domains.

Strong technical acumen with the ability to understand and shape AI agent design & prompt writing.

Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, comfortable engaging with executive stakeholders.

Ability to thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where you help shape solutions as much as you deliver them.

(Preferred) Background in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent technical experience.

Why should you consider us seriously?

We believe that longer-term, people >> product & profits and prioritize culture over everything else.

We are a well-balanced team of experienced entrepreneurs and are backed by top investors across India and Silicon Valley.

Freedom and Responsibility.

Entrepreneurial Team.

Exponential Growth.

Healthcare (Physical & Mental Wellness).

Pay: ₹784,000.00 - ₹2,310,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Product Manager - Transactions
job_description:
About the company:

A Series A consumer fintech in Bengaluru, backed by top-tier VCs and founded by a former CXO of one of India's largest e-commerce unicorns. The company is building India's first agentic AI credit product, helping Indians access and manage credit.

The role:

Own the payments and transactions experience of an AI-powered credit platform: the money moments where users pay and transact. Your goal is to make them so effortless that users never have to think about them. You will work closely with Tech, Product and Design teams, where AI is part of everyday work.

What you will need:

- 3 to 6 years of product experience building consumer products at scale (non-MBAs preferred)

- A generalist, consumer-first PM who obsesses over the user journey and sweats the details end to end

- A problem-first mindset: you start from the user problem, not the solution

- Curiosity and hunger to learn, including genuine interest in AI and fintech

- A degree from a Tier 1 institute (mandatory)

What is on offer:

- CTC of Rs 35 to 45 lakh per annum

- Generous ESOPs, health insurance and productivity reimbursements

- Work from office in Bengaluru, 5 to 6 days a week depending on the work

- Notice period of up to 60 days can be considered

This role is being hired through J2L Technologies, a Bengaluru recruitment partner. The client name is shared at the screening stage. No fee is charged to candidates.

Pay: ₹3,500,000.00 - ₹4,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager - FMCG
job_description:
We are looking for a dynamic, result-oriented, and hands-on **FMCG Product Manager** who can take complete ownership of product development, new product launches, brand management, and market growth.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the entire product lifecycle, starting from identifying new product opportunities and conducting market research to product development, manufacturing coordination, branding, packaging, pricing, market launch, and sales growth.

The role requires practical experience in launching FMCG products through both offline and online channels, including e-commerce marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, and other relevant platforms.

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently driving product execution, coordinating with multiple departments, and converting product ideas into commercially successful products.

Key Responsibilities1. Market Research & Product Identification

* Conduct market research to identify new product opportunities, emerging trends, and consumer requirements.
* Analyse competitor products, pricing, packaging, positioning, and market performance.
* Identify potential FMCG product categories and recommend new products based on market demand and business opportunities.
* Evaluate product feasibility, target audiences, market potential, and expected profitability.
* Develop product concepts and business proposals for new product launches.

2. Product Development & Manufacturing Coordination

* Manage the complete product development process from concept to final product.
* Coordinate with R&D, manufacturing, procurement, and quality control teams for product formulation and development.
* Work on product specifications, ingredients, quality standards, costing, and production requirements.
* Coordinate product sampling, testing, packaging development, and final approvals.
* Ensure products meet quality requirements, cost targets, and planned launch timelines.

3. Branding, Packaging & Pricing

* Manage product naming, branding, positioning, packaging design, and label development.
* Coordinate with graphic designers, creative agencies, and marketing teams for product packaging and branding.
* Develop product pricing strategies based on manufacturing costs, competitor pricing, market positioning, and profit margins.
* Ensure packaging and product communication are aligned with applicable regulatory and labelling requirements.

4. New Product Launch & Go-to-Market Strategy

* Independently plan and execute new FMCG product launches.
* Develop and implement Go-to-Market (GTM) strategies for new products.
* Coordinate all pre-launch and post-launch activities to ensure successful market entry.
* Plan product availability, distribution, promotional activities, and sales channel readiness.
* Monitor initial market response and implement strategies to improve product acceptance and sales.

5. E-commerce & Marketplace Management

* Manage end-to-end product launches and operations across e-commerce platforms.
* Handle product listings, catalog creation, product titles, descriptions, images, keywords, and SEO optimization.
* Manage product presence across Amazon, Flipkart, JioMart, and other relevant online marketplaces.
* Coordinate marketplace promotions, advertising, discounts, and online visibility campaigns.
* Monitor product rankings, customer reviews, ratings, conversion rates, and online sales performance.
* Identify opportunities to expand online distribution and improve marketplace sales.

6. Offline Sales & Distribution Management

* Work with sales teams to establish products in offline markets.
* Coordinate with distributors, dealers, retailers, and channel partners for product distribution.
* Develop strategies for retail penetration, product availability, and market expansion.
* Support sales teams with product knowledge, pricing information, and promotional plans.
* Monitor product-wise sales performance across different distribution channels.

7. Marketing & Brand Growth

* Work closely with marketing teams to plan and execute product marketing strategies.
* Coordinate digital marketing, social media campaigns, advertising, and promotional activities.
* Develop product communication and marketing content in collaboration with creative teams.
* Identify brand-building opportunities to increase product awareness and market demand.
* Track campaign performance and recommend improvements to increase sales and brand visibility.

8. Product Performance & Business Management

* Monitor product-wise sales, revenue, profit margins, and overall business performance.
* Manage product costing, pricing, budgets, and profitability.
* Analyse customer feedback, market response, and sales data to identify improvement opportunities.
* Coordinate inventory planning, demand forecasting, and supply chain requirements.
* Prepare regular product performance reports and present business updates to management.
* Take corrective actions to improve product performance and achieve business growth targets.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, or a related field. MBA preferred.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in FMCG Product Management, Product Development, Brand Management, or New Product Launch.
* Proven hands-on experience in successfully launching FMCG products in the market.
* Strong understanding of the complete product lifecycle, from concept development to commercial launch.
* Practical experience in product branding, packaging, costing, pricing, and market positioning.
* Hands-on knowledge of e-commerce platforms, particularly Amazon Seller Central and Flipkart Seller Hub.
* Understanding of marketplace SEO, product listing optimization, catalog management, and online sales operations.
* Experience in offline distribution, retail markets, and sales channel development.
* Strong understanding of consumer behaviour, market research, competitor analysis, and FMCG market dynamics.
* Excellent coordination, communication, negotiation, and project management skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple products and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
* Strong analytical and commercial mindset with a focus on sales, profitability, and business growth.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Candidates who have independently handled FMCG products from initial concept to successful market launch.
* Experience in launching new brands or product categories.
* Candidates with practical exposure to both e-commerce marketplaces and offline retail distribution.
* Experience working with manufacturing units, vendors, packaging agencies, and marketing teams.
* Candidates who can take ownership of product execution rather than only handling planning or coordination.

Key Performance Expectations (KPIs)

The candidate's performance will be evaluated on:

* Successful development and launch of new products.
* Timely execution of product launches.
* Growth in product-wise sales and revenue.
* E-commerce sales and marketplace performance.
* Offline market penetration and distribution expansion.
* Product profitability and margin management.
* Brand visibility and market acceptance.

**Important:** This is an end-to-end product ownership role. The selected candidate will be expected to independently drive assigned products from market research and product development to launch, distribution, e-commerce operations, sales performance, and long-term business growth.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Experience:

* total work: 3 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently driving product execution, coordinating with multiple departments, and converting product ideas into commercially successful products.

Key Responsibilities1. Market Research & Product Identification

* Conduct market research to identify new product opportunities, emerging trends, and consumer requirements.
* Analyse competitor products, pricing, packaging, positioning, and market performance.
* Identify potential FMCG product categories and recommend new products based on market demand and business opportunities.
* Evaluate product feasibility, target audiences, market potential, and expected profitability.
* Develop product concepts and business proposals for new product launches.

2. Product Development & Manufacturing Coordination

* Manage the complete product development process from concept to final product.
* Coordinate with R&D, manufacturing, procurement, and quality control teams for product formulation and development.
* Work on product specifications, ingredients, quality standards, costing, and production requirements.
* Coordinate product sampling, testing, packaging development, and final approvals.
* Ensure products meet quality requirements, cost targets, and planned launch timelines.

3. Branding, Packaging & Pricing

* Manage product naming, branding, positioning, packaging design, and label development.
* Coordinate with graphic designers, creative agencies, and marketing teams for product packaging and branding.
* Develop product pricing strategies based on manufacturing costs, competitor pricing, market positioning, and profit margins.
* Ensure packaging and product communication are aligned with applicable regulatory and labelling requirements.

4. New Product Launch & Go-to-Market Strategy

* Independently plan and execute new FMCG product launches.
* Develop and implement Go-to-Market (GTM) strategies for new products.
* Coordinate all pre-launch and post-launch activities to ensure successful market entry.
* Plan product availability, distribution, promotional activities, and sales channel readiness.
* Monitor initial market response and implement strategies to improve product acceptance and sales.

5. E-commerce & Marketplace Management

* Manage end-to-end product launches and operations across e-commerce platforms.
* Handle product listings, catalog creation, product titles, descriptions, images, keywords, and SEO optimization.
* Manage product presence across Amazon, Flipkart, JioMart, and other relevant online marketplaces.
* Coordinate marketplace promotions, advertising, discounts, and online visibility campaigns.
* Monitor product rankings, customer reviews, ratings, conversion rates, and online sales performance.
* Identify opportunities to expand online distribution and improve marketplace sales.

6. Offline Sales & Distribution Management

* Work with sales teams to establish products in offline markets.
* Coordinate with distributors, dealers, retailers, and channel partners for product distribution.
* Develop strategies for retail penetration, product availability, and market expansion.
* Support sales teams with product knowledge, pricing information, and promotional plans.
* Monitor product-wise sales performance across different distribution channels.

7. Marketing & Brand Growth

* Work closely with marketing teams to plan and execute product marketing strategies.
* Coordinate digital marketing, social media campaigns, advertising, and promotional activities.
* Develop product communication and marketing content in collaboration with creative teams.
* Identify brand-building opportunities to increase product awareness and market demand.
* Track campaign performance and recommend improvements to increase sales and brand visibility.

8. Product Performance & Business Management

* Monitor product-wise sales, revenue, profit margins, and overall business performance.
* Manage product costing, pricing, budgets, and profitability.
* Analyse customer feedback, market response, and sales data to identify improvement opportunities.
* Coordinate inventory planning, demand forecasting, and supply chain requirements.
* Prepare regular product performance reports and present business updates to management.
* Take corrective actions to improve product performance and achieve business growth targets.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, or a related field. MBA preferred.
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in FMCG Product Management, Product Development, Brand Management, or New Product Launch.
* Proven hands-on experience in successfully launching FMCG products in the market.
* Strong understanding of the complete product lifecycle, from concept development to commercial launch.
* Practical experience in product branding, packaging, costing, pricing, and market positioning.
* Hands-on knowledge of e-commerce platforms, particularly Amazon Seller Central and Flipkart Seller Hub.
* Understanding of marketplace SEO, product listing optimization, catalog management, and online sales operations.
* Experience in offline distribution, retail markets, and sales channel development.
* Strong understanding of consumer behaviour, market research, competitor analysis, and FMCG market dynamics.
* Excellent coordination, communication, negotiation, and project management skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple products and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
* Strong analytical and commercial mindset with a focus on sales, profitability, and business growth.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Candidates who have independently handled FMCG products from initial concept to successful market launch.
* Experience in launching new brands or product categories.
* Candidates with practical exposure to both e-commerce marketplaces and offline retail distribution.
* Experience working with manufacturing units, vendors, packaging agencies, and marketing teams.
* Candidates who can take ownership of product execution rather than only handling planning or coordination.

Key Performance Expectations (KPIs)

The candidate's performance will be evaluated on:

* Successful development and launch of new products.
* Timely execution of product launches.
* Growth in product-wise sales and revenue.
* E-commerce sales and marketplace performance.
* Offline market penetration and distribution expansion.
* Product profitability and margin management.
* Brand visibility and market acceptance.

**Important:** This is an end-to-end product ownership role. The selected candidate will be expected to independently drive assigned products from market research and product development to launch, distribution, e-commerce operations, sales performance, and long-term business growth.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Experience:

* total work: 3 years (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

About the company:

A Series A consumer fintech in Bengaluru, backed by top-tier VCs and founded by a former CXO of one of India's largest e-commerce unicorns. The company is building India's first agentic AI credit product, helping Indians access and manage credit.

The role:

Help build and scale an agentic credit product, a self-driven system that helps users manage and improve their credit on their own. Here AI is the product, not a feature on top. You will own problems most companies have not hit yet, working closely with Tech, Product and Design teams, where AI is part of everyday work.

What you will need:

- 3 to 6 years of product experience (non-MBAs preferred)

- Hands-on experience building prototypes with AI tools, including vibe coding

- Solid technical understanding of how LLMs work, including context, retrieval and failure modes, beyond just prompting

- Exposure to agent memory, evals or multi-agent systems

- The judgement to tell whether a problem is a model limitation or a product design issue, and real care for users' biases and blind spots

- Passion for AI-driven products and genuine curiosity about fintech

What is on offer:

- CTC of Rs 35 to 45 lakh per annum

- Generous ESOPs, health insurance and productivity reimbursements

- Work from office in Bengaluru, 5 to 6 days a week depending on the work

- Notice period of up to 60 days can be considered

This role is being hired through J2L Technologies, a Bengaluru recruitment partner. The client name is shared at the screening stage. No fee is charged to candidates.

Pay: ₹3,500,000.00 - ₹4,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Job Description:**

The Product Manager will be responsible for defining product strategy, managing the product roadmap, gathering business requirements, prioritizing product features, and driving successful product delivery from concept through production. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with engineering, design, QA, business stakeholders, and customers to deliver scalable, high-quality healthcare software solutions.

This role requires a strategic thinker with strong analytical capabilities, excellent stakeholder management skills, and extensive experience building software products for the US healthcare industry.

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Strategy & Vision

* Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, and roadmap aligned with business objectives.
* Identify market opportunities through customer research, competitive analysis, and industry trends.
* Translate business goals into product initiatives and measurable outcomes.
* Drive innovation by identifying opportunities to improve healthcare workflows and operational efficiency.

2. Product Roadmap & Planning

* Develop and maintain the product roadmap.
* Define release plans, milestones, and feature priorities.
* Balance customer needs, technical feasibility, business value, and delivery timelines.
* Collaborate with leadership to align product investments with organizational goals.

3. Product Backlog Management

* Own and manage the product backlog.
* Create, prioritize, and refine backlog items based on business value and customer impact.
* Ensure backlog items are detailed, actionable, and ready for development.
* Manage feature dependencies and coordinate with multiple teams.

4. Requirement Gathering & Documentation

* Work closely with business stakeholders, customers, operations teams, and engineering teams to gather requirements.
* Prepare and maintain:
* Business Requirement Documents (BRD)
* Functional Requirement Documents (FRD)
* User Stories
* Acceptance Criteria
* Functional Specifications
* Product Requirement Documents (PRD)
* Create user flows, workflow diagrams, business process maps, and functional documentation.
* Ensure requirements are complete, traceable, and aligned with business objectives.

5. Agile Product Management

* Serve as the Product Manager within Agile Scrum teams.
* Lead backlog refinement sessions.
* Participate in Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
* Define sprint goals and collaborate with engineering teams to achieve sprint commitments.
* Support estimation, planning, and release management activities.

6. Cross-functional Leadership

Collaborate closely with:

* Software Development Teams
* QA Engineers
* Business Analysts
* UI/UX Designers
* DevOps Engineers
* Customer Success Teams
* Operations Teams
* Executive Leadership
* External Customers and Business Stakeholders
* Provide timely clarifications, facilitate decision-making, and remove functional blockers to ensure successful product delivery.

7. Product Validation & Release Management

* Define acceptance criteria for all product features.
* Review completed features against business requirements.
* Participate in sprint demonstrations and release reviews.
* Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Validate production readiness prior to release.
* Support production deployments and post-release monitoring.

8. Stakeholder Management

* Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and engineering teams.
* Present product roadmaps, release plans, and product progress to leadership.
* Facilitate discussions to resolve functional and business challenges.
* Ensure stakeholder expectations are managed effectively.

9. Product Performance & Continuous Improvement

* Define product success metrics and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
* Analyze customer feedback and product usage data.
* Identify opportunities for product enhancements and process improvements.
* Drive continuous product innovation and optimization.

Required Skills & Competencies

1. Product Management

* Product Vision and Strategy
* Product Roadmap Planning
* Product Lifecycle Management
* Product Discovery
* Product Backlog Management
* Feature Prioritization
* Stakeholder Management
* Business Analysis
* Requirement Gathering

2. Agile Methodologies

* Agile Scrum
* Sprint Planning
* Sprint Reviews
* Sprint Retrospectives
* Backlog Refinement
* Release Planning
* User Story Writing
* Story Estimation
* Agile Product Delivery

3. Documentation

* Business Requirement Documents (BRD)
* Functional Requirement Documents (FRD)
* Product Requirement Documents (PRD)
* User Stories
* Acceptance Criteria
* Functional Specifications
* User Flow Diagrams
* Process Flow Documentation
* Release Documentation

4. Functional Expertise

* Business Workflow Analysis
* Business Rules Definition
* Functional Design
* Validation Rules
* Process Optimization
* Gap Analysis
* Solution Design

5. Collaboration

Experience working with:

* Software Developers
* QA Teams
* UI/UX Designers
* DevOps Teams
* Executive Leadership
* Customers

6. Product Validation

* Product Demonstrations
* User Acceptance Testing (UAT)
* Acceptance Testing
* Feature Validation
* Production Readiness Reviews

Domain Expertise (Mandatory)

The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience in US Healthcare and Revenue Cycle Management (RCM).

1. US Healthcare

* Electronic Health Records (EHR/EMR)
* HIPAA Compliance
* Patient Registration
* Appointment Scheduling
* Clinical Workflows
* Healthcare Operations
* Healthcare Compliance

2. Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)

* Patient Eligibility Verification
* Benefits Verification
* Prior Authorization
* Medical Coding (ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS)
* Charge Capture
* Medical Billing
* Claims Submission
* Claims Processing
* Payment Posting
* Denial Management
* Appeals
* Accounts Receivable (AR)
* Insurance Workflows
* Patient Collections
* Clearinghouse Integrations
* Knowledge of HL7, FHIR, and healthcare interoperability standards is highly desirable.

Preferred Tools

* Azure DevOps
* Jira
* Confluence
* Microsoft Office Suite

Experience

* 10+ years of experience in Product Management or Product Ownership.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in US Healthcare software products.
* Strong experience with Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) products.
* Proven experience delivering enterprise SaaS applications using Agile methodologies.

Preferred Certifications

* Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO)
* Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO)

Key Competencies

* Strategic thinking and product vision
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Leadership and stakeholder management
* Customer-centric mindset
* Decision-making and prioritization
* Negotiation and conflict resolution
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced Agile environment
* Strong organizational and time management skills

Pay: ₹100,000.00 - ₹125,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Department:** Product Management & Business Development  
**Designation:** Product Manager – SBT Tool  
**Location:** Andheri East, Mumbai  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Reporting To:** Management / Business Head

1. Job Purpose

HEC Hospitality is looking for a dynamic, commercially driven and result-oriented Product Manager to take ownership of the SBT (Software-Based Tool) product, from its successful launch to market expansion and business growth.

The candidate will be responsible for coordinating with software vendors and technical partners to ensure the product is successfully developed, tested and made live. Following the product launch, the primary responsibility will be to introduce the SBT Tool to the market, acquire clients, conduct product demonstrations, onboard customers and ensure effective product utilisation.

The role will carry direct sales and revenue responsibilities, with performance-linked incentives. As the business expands, the candidate will also be responsible for developing and leading a dedicated sales and customer support team.

2. Key Roles & Responsibilities

**A. Product Launch & Vendor Management**

* Coordinate with software vendors, technology partners and internal stakeholders for the successful launch of the SBT Tool.
* Ensure timely completion of software development, API integration, testing and implementation activities.
* Track project milestones, deliverables and pending technical requirements.
* Conduct product testing and coordinate necessary modifications before the final go-live.
* Act as the primary coordination point between management, software vendors and internal teams.
* Ensure all technical and operational dependencies are addressed before launching the product in the market.
* Monitor vendor performance and ensure timely resolution of technical issues and product enhancements.

**B. Product Strategy & Market Development**

* Take complete ownership of introducing and positioning the SBT Tool in the target market.
* Develop strategies for product promotion, market penetration and business expansion.
* Identify potential industries, businesses and clients that can benefit from the SBT Tool.
* Conduct direct client meetings, presentations and product demonstrations.
* Understand market requirements, competitor offerings and customer expectations.
* Identify opportunities to improve product features and commercial positioning.
* Build a strong client pipeline and establish the product's market presence.

**C. Sales & Business Development**

* Drive end-to-end sales activities for the SBT Tool.
* Generate leads through direct meetings, networking, references, cold calling and other business development channels.
* Present product features, benefits and business value propositions to prospective clients.
* Prepare commercial proposals, quotations and negotiate deals within approved company pricing.
* Convert prospective clients into active customers.
* Achieve assigned monthly, quarterly and annual sales and revenue targets.
* Maintain regular follow-ups with prospective clients and ensure timely deal closures.
* Explore cross-selling, upselling and additional business opportunities.

**D. Client Onboarding & Implementation**

* Manage the complete client onboarding process, from commercial closure to successful product activation.
* Understand client requirements and coordinate with technical teams for appropriate implementation.
* Ensure clients receive proper product demonstrations, training and usage guidance.
* Coordinate with vendors and support teams to ensure smooth implementation.
* Monitor onboarding timelines and ensure clients start using the software effectively.
* Maintain strong relationships with newly onboarded and existing clients.

**E. Client Performance & Product Utilisation**

* Regularly track the performance and utilisation of the SBT Tool across onboarded clients.
* Monitor active users, product adoption, usage patterns and customer engagement.
* Conduct periodic client reviews to understand satisfaction and identify improvement areas.
* Collect feedback and communicate enhancement requirements to vendors and technical teams.
* Ensure client issues are resolved within agreed timelines.
* Monitor customer retention, renewals and opportunities for account growth.
* Prepare monthly reports on client performance, product adoption and revenue contribution.

**F. Revenue & Business Performance Management**

* Take direct ownership of the product's commercial performance and revenue growth.
* Establish sales targets and business development milestones in consultation with management.
* Monitor lead generation, conversion ratios, client acquisition and revenue performance.
* Track sales pipeline, deal closures and pending payments.
* Analyse business performance and identify opportunities to improve profitability.
* Present periodic business review reports to management with achievements, challenges and action plans.

**G. Team Building & Leadership**

* Initially manage product sales, client onboarding and business development activities.
* Gradually recruit, develop and lead a dedicated team of sales executives and customer support personnel.
* Allocate targets and responsibilities to team members.
* Monitor individual and team performance through structured MIS and reporting.
* Train the team on product knowledge, sales techniques, client handling and onboarding procedures.
* Establish standard operating procedures for sales, onboarding and customer support.
* Ensure coordination between sales, operations, technical vendors and customer support teams.
* Drive overall team productivity and achievement of business targets.

3. Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong product management and business development capabilities.
* Proven experience in B2B sales, software sales
* Excellent client-facing, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Understanding of software implementation, API integration and product deployment.
* Ability to coordinate with technical vendors and translate business requirements into actionable deliverables.
* Strong market research and business development skills.
* Experience in client acquisition, onboarding

Pay: ₹1,000,000.00 - ₹1,200,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Assistant Product Manager
job_description:
#### **Role Overview**

We are looking for a sharp, data-driven, and user-obsessed **Associate Product Manager** to join our product team. As a fresher or recent graduate with strong SQL and analytical capabilities, you will work directly with Senior Product Managers, Engineering, Design, Credit/Risk, and Operations teams to build and optimize seamless digital financial journeys, from customer onboarding and KYC to loan disbursals and repayments.

#### **Key Result Areas (KRAs) & Responsibilities**

* **Data Extraction & Funnel Analytics (SQL-Driven):** Write complex SQL queries to pull product telemetry, analyze customer drop-offs across onboarding, e-KYC, credit underwriting, and payment funnels, and identify high-impact friction points.
* **Requirement Gathering & Documentation:** Assist in writing clear Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), user stories, and acceptance criteria backed by data insights for mobile app and web features.
* **Experimentation & Metric Tracking:** Define success metrics, build self-serve dashboards, and track post-launch feature adoption, conversion rates, and retention cohorts.
* **Cross-Functional Execution:** Collaborate closely with UI/UX designers, tech leads, and QA teams during sprint planning, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and product releases.
* **Compliance & Risk Alignment:** Work alongside Risk, Fraud Control (FCU), and Compliance teams to ensure product flows adhere to RBI digital lending guidelines and data security standards.

#### **Eligibility & Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (B.Tech/B.E., BBA, B.Com, Economics, Statistics, MBA, or related quantitative fields) , **2025 or 2026 graduates only**.
* **Prior Exposure (Preferred):** Internships, live projects, data/product case study competitions, or academic projects involving SQL querying, product analytics, or fintech workflows.

#### **Skills & Competencies**

* **Strong SQL Proficiency (Must-Have):** Hands-on ability to write clean, efficient SQL queries (joins, subqueries, CTEs, window functions, and aggregations) to independently analyze large transactional and user-event datasets.
* **Analytical & Quantitative Mindset:** Comfort with Excel/Google Sheets and interpreting product/fintech metrics (funnel conversion, TAT, cohort retention, approval rates).
* **Product Sense:** Strong user empathy, wireframing basics (Figma/Balsamiq), and the ability to break complex financial workflows into simple user steps.
* **Communication & Agility:** Ability to translate raw data and business requirements into structured documentation for engineering teams while thriving in a fast-paced environment.

job_description:
**Product Manager**

**Location:** Sector 32, Gurgaon, Haryana  
**Role Type:** Full-time, Work from Office  
**Experience:** 3–8 years of direct & relevant experience  
**Industry Preference:** EdTech, Education SaaS, Content-Tech, NGO, CSR, or Development sector  
**1. About iDream Education**  
**Vision:** Unlimited Learning. Unlimited Growth. For Everyone.  
**Belief:** We believe that access to learning and growth is a fundamental right, and that learning in its truest sense is the joyful unfolding of a being’s fullest potential — in all dimensions of life.  
**Mission:** To deliver solutions and experiences that facilitate access to learning and growth for everyone, irrespective of their languages, geographies, abilities, curricula, age groups, learning styles, and socio-economic status.iPrep by iDream Education is a Learning Platform that runs both offline & online, is bilingual and works on all major hardware devices and operating systems. iPrep delivers curriculum-aligned digital learning for classes 1st to 12th in English, Hindi, and Regional language mediums for universal reach and learning use as:• iPrep Digital Class for Smart Classrooms• iPrep Digital Library for Tablets/Notebooks based Smart ICT Labs• iPrep PAL for Personalised Adaptive Learning• iPrep Tablets for Preloaded Learning Devices with Monitoring• iPrep App for a one-stop learning platform across Android, iOS, and WebThrough iPrep, iDream Education empowers teachers and students, both in schools and at home to **Learn Unlimited.**Company website: **www.idreameducation.org** | iPrep website: www.iprep.in

**2. Role Summary**  
The Product Manager at iDream Education sits at the intersection of product, design, engineering, and the field. You will define what gets built, ensure it is built right, and make sure it solves real problems for the students, teachers, and administrators who use our products every day.You will work across both internal tools and the iPrep suite of products — partnering closely with design, engineering, ops, content, and sales, as well as with field counterparts — leading roadmap planning and prioritisation in close partnership with the founders.

**3. Key Responsibilities & Deliverables**

**Own the Spec Layer**

* Translate requests from ops, content, sales, and marketing into clear, structured product requirements before they reach engineering.
* Define acceptance criteria, timelines, and priorities for every piece of work entering the engineering pipeline.
* Eliminate ambiguity as a default — no ticket moves to development without a written spec.

**Bridge Design and Engineering**

* Work closely with the design team to drive iterations to finality — own sign-off gates so engineering always builds against confirmed designs.
* Be the single point of accountability for design-to-development handoffs.
* Reduce rework by making design decisions explicit and time-bound.

**Stakeholder Interface**

* Be the primary point of contact for internal teams — ops, content, sales, marketing — channelling their needs into the product process.
* Interface with field counterparts and school-level stakeholders to surface ground realities and unvoiced user needs.
* Represent product context clearly across very different audiences — from engineers to field coordinators.

**Roadmap Planning and Prioritisation**

* Lead roadmap planning in close partnership with the founders — synthesising inputs from internal teams, field signals, and usage data.
* Identify unvoiced opportunities: gaps that no one is articulating yet but that the data or field context reveals.
* Work with our data analysts to bring usage evidence into prioritisation discussions — not just instinct.

**4. Qualifications & Experience**

**Education:** Graduate in any discipline; a background in Product Management, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field is preferred. However, candidates with a strong track record in product management, product strategy, or cross-functional product development will also be considered regardless of their specific degree.  
**Experience:** 3–8 years of experience in Product Management, preferably in a technology, SaaS, EdTech, or digital product environment. A proven track record includes successfully defining product requirements, collaborating with cross-functional teams, driving product launches, and delivering measurable business and user outcomes through data-driven product decisions.

**Other Requirements:** Comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet product delivery timelines. Strong collaboration with engineering, design, business, and other stakeholders is essential. This is primarily an office-based role located in Gurugram, Haryana, with minimal travel as required for customer interactions, workshops, or business meetings.

**5. Key Skills & Competencies**

* 3–8 years of total relevant experience, with at least 1–2 years directly in a product team (as PM, Associate PM, Business Analyst, or similar adjacent role).
* You have been a member of a product team — you understand how good product development works from the inside, even if PM wasn’t your exact title.
* You write with structure and clarity. Your specs, briefs, and updates leave no room for misinterpretation.
* You are comfortable with data — you can pull the right numbers, read them honestly, and use them to make a case or change your mind.
* You thrive in environments where influence matters more than authority. You can align people who don’t report to you.
* You are energised by working closely with founders — you see it as an advantage, not a constraint.
* You genuinely care about the problem: quality education reaching every child, regardless of where they grow up.
* You are coachable and self-aware — you know what you don’t know, and you’re not threatened by it.

**6. What We're Looking For — Values & Culture Fit**

* **Integrity:** Makes transparent, data-driven product decisions and takes ownership of outcomes.
* **Impact:** Builds products that solve real customer problems and drive measurable business value.
* **Excellence:** Continuously improves the product through user insights, data, and innovation.
* **Collaboration:** Works seamlessly with cross-functional teams to deliver successful product outcomes.

**7. Why Join Us**  
This is a high-ownership role at the center of our product development, where your work directly bridges the gap between field realities and engineering execution. You will partner closely with the founders to shape the roadmap of the iPrep suite, ensuring our products solve real-world problems for students and teachers across India. Join us to build, measure, and scale solutions that make "Unlimited Learning" a reality for every child, while advancing your product leadership in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹1,800,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* What is your current CTC ?
* what is your notice period ?
* what is your current location ?
* what is your expected CTC?

Experience:

* Product management: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

Product Manager – Consumer Product

**Company:** Be10x  
**Department:** Product – Engagement, Retention & Growth  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Experience:** 3–5 Years  
**Work Location:** As per company requirements

Job Overview

Be10x is looking for a **Product Manager** to own a core domain of our consumer product **end-to-end**.

This is a high-ownership role where you will be responsible for taking products from **problem discovery and ideation to strategy, roadmap, development, launch, measurement, and continuous optimisation**.

You will work closely with Engineering, Design, and Product leadership while being accountable for business outcomes such as **engagement, retention, activation, and conversion**.

Key Responsibilities

* Own the **product/domain end-to-end**, from identifying customer problems to delivering measurable business outcomes.
* Define product vision, strategy, roadmap, priorities, and success metrics.
* Conduct product discovery using user research, behavioural data, and business insights.
* Identify opportunities to improve the customer journey, engagement, retention, activation, and conversion.
* Analyse funnels, cohorts, user journeys, and product performance to identify drop-offs and growth opportunities.
* Create clear **PRDs, product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria**.
* Work closely with Engineering and Design teams to plan, build, launch, and iterate features.
* Make product prioritisation and trade-off decisions based on customer value and business impact.
* Drive the complete product lifecycle: **Discovery → Strategy → Roadmap → Development → Launch → Measurement → Optimisation**.
* Design and run **A/B tests and product experiments** and use learnings to improve the product.
* Monitor product KPIs and continuously optimise product performance.
* Align cross-functional teams and stakeholders around product direction and priorities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* **3–5 years of Product Management experience** in a **B2C / consumer digital product**.
* Proven experience in **end-to-end product ownership**.
* Ability to independently own a product/domain and drive it from **problem identification to measurable business results**.
* Strong understanding of **Product Strategy, Product Vision, Product Roadmapping, Product Discovery, and Product Execution**.
* Strong **product sense** and ability to identify high-impact customer problems.
* Strong **data-driven decision-making** and product analytics skills.
* Hands-on experience with **Mixpanel, Amplitude, Google Analytics, or similar product analytics tools**.
* Strong understanding of **funnels, cohorts, user journeys, engagement, retention, activation, and conversion metrics**.
* Experience with **A/B testing, experimentation, hypothesis-driven product development, and iteration**.
* Strong skills in writing **PRDs, product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria**.
* Strong **prioritisation and stakeholder management** skills.
* Ability to make product trade-offs based on **customer impact, business value, data, and technical feasibility**.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to align **Engineering, Design, Product, and Leadership**.
* Experience working closely with Engineering and Design teams to **ship products/features from concept to production**.
* Ability to take complete ownership of problems and drive them to resolution **without requiring constant supervision**.
* Comfortable working in a **fast-paced Agile product development environment**.

Nice to Have

* Experience in **EdTech, E-learning, LMS, or consumer learning products**.
* Experience in **Growth, Lifecycle, Engagement, or Retention Product Management**.
* Experience working on **customer acquisition and activation funnels**.
* Experience shipping products across **Web and Mobile (iOS/Android)**.
* Experience working in a **high-growth consumer technology/product company**.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who **owns outcomes, not just a backlog**.

You should be comfortable taking a problem, understanding the customer, defining the right solution, building the roadmap, working with Engineering and Design, launching the product, analysing results, and continuously improving it.

**End-to-end ownership of the product is a core requirement for this role.**

Pay: ₹100,000.00 - ₹300,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience in consumer product company??

Experience:

* Product management: 3 years (Required)
* End-To-End ownership of the Product: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

job_description:
**About Valeo Health**  
Valeo Health is a preventive healthcare and wellness platform operating across Saudi Arabia (KSA) and the United Arab Emirates (UAE), offering diagnostics, tele-consultation, AI-driven health insights, supplements, and care programs. We are building AI-first, compliant, and scalable healthcare platforms that handle sensitive health data while delivering reliable, high-quality customer experiences across geographies.

**About the role**  
We are looking for a Product Manager to own internal products and processes that make our operations, finance and compliance run faster, cleaner and at scale across India and the GCC (UAE, KSA, Qatar). You will work closely with Operations, Finance and Business teams to turn messy operational problems into clear problem statements, ship solutions with engineering, and measure the efficiency gains.

**Key responsibilities**

* Own the roadmap for operational efficiency: identify bottlenecks in ops, finance and business workflows, and prioritise them by impact.
* Turn stakeholder pain points into clear problem statements, PRDs and success metrics.
* Partner with engineering and design to ship automation, internal tools and process improvements end to end.
* Work with Finance on billing, payments, reconciliation, invoicing and reporting flows, including tax (GST, VAT) and audit requirements.
* Ensure products meet regulatory and compliance requirements in the GCC markets (UAE, KSA, Qatar, Kuwait), including data protection and healthcare regulations.
* Support market launches in the GCC with localisation of operational, finance and compliance processes.
* Define and track KPIs such as turnaround time, cost per transaction, error rates and manual effort saved.
* Manage stakeholders across Ops, Finance, Business and leadership: set expectations, share regular updates and drive decisions.
* Drive adoption and change management so new tools and processes are actually used.

**Must-have qualifications**

* 2+ years of experience as a Product Manager, ideally on internal tools, operations or B2B / platform products.
* Proven track record of shipping products that delivered measurable efficiency or cost improvements.
* Strong problem structuring: able to break down ambiguous operational problems and prioritise ruthlessly.
* Comfortable with data: SQL or spreadsheet analysis, defining metrics and reading dashboards.
* Excellent stakeholder management, with experience working with non-technical teams such as Ops and Finance.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including PRDs, status updates and leadership reviews.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, finance or a related field.

**Good to have**

* Working knowledge of corporate finance: P&L, unit economics, cash flow, budgeting and financial reporting.
* Familiarity with tax frameworks such as VAT / Zakat in the GCC, and e-invoicing requirements.
* Exposure to regulatory and compliance requirements in the GCC (UAE, KSA, Qatar), such as data protection laws and licensing.
* Experience in health-tech, including healthcare regulations, patient or provider workflows and handling sensitive health data.
* Background in operations, consulting or finance before moving into product.
* Experience with process automation, ERP or finance tools (for example Zoho Books, NetSuite, SAP), workflow tools and integrations.
* Experience launching products or operations in new markets.

**What we offer**

* High ownership over problems that directly affect cost, speed and scale of the business.
* Exposure to multi-market expansion across the GCC.
* Close work with leadership and cross-functional teams.

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

* Strong problem structuring: able to break down ambiguous operational problems and prioritise ruthlessly.
* Comfortable with data: SQL or spreadsheet analysis, defining metrics and reading dashboards.
* Excellent stakeholder management, with experience working with non-technical teams such as Ops and Finance.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including PRDs, status updates and leadership reviews.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, finance or a related field.

**Good to have**

* Working knowledge of corporate finance: P&L, unit economics, cash flow, budgeting and financial reporting.
* Familiarity with tax frameworks such as VAT / Zakat in the GCC, and e-invoicing requirements.
* Exposure to regulatory and compliance requirements in the GCC (UAE, KSA, Qatar), such as data protection laws and licensing.
* Experience in health-tech, including healthcare regulations, patient or provider workflows and handling sensitive health data.
* Background in operations, consulting or finance before moving into product.
* Experience with process automation, ERP or finance tools (for example Zoho Books, NetSuite, SAP), workflow tools and integrations.
* Experience launching products or operations in new markets.

**What we offer**

* High ownership over problems that directly affect cost, speed and scale of the business.
* Exposure to multi-market expansion across the GCC.
* Close work with leadership and cross-functional teams.

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
title: Salesforce Product Manager
job_description:
Huron is redefining what a global consulting organization can be. Advancing new ideas every day to build even stronger clients, individuals and communities. We’re helping our clients find new ways to drive growth, enhance business performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. And, we’re developing strategies and implementing solutions that enable the transformative change they need to own their future.  
  
As a member of the Huron corporate team, you’ll help to evolve our business model to stay ahead of market forces, industry trends and client needs. Our accounting, finance, human resources, IT, legal, marketing and facilities management professionals work collaboratively to support Huron’s collective strategies and enable real transformation to produce sustainable business results.  
  
Join our team and create your future.

The Salesforce Product Manager will shape how Huron uses Salesforce to enable and transform our Business Solutions capabilities. This leader will combine deep Salesforce functional knowledge, strong business partnership, product leadership, and people leadership to turn business needs into cohesive, scalable solutions that deliver measurable value.  
  
The ideal candidate understands how Salesforce works out of the box and can envision an end-to-end solution before determining where Huron-specific capabilities are needed. They will connect business strategy with platform capabilities, challenge assumptions, guide product decisions, and lead cross-functional teams from discovery through adoption and continuous improvement

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Ownership

* Define and maintain the Salesforce product vision, roadmap, priorities, and backlog aligned with Business Solutions objectives.
* Translate business strategies and desired outcomes into product capabilities, requirements, and measurable outcomes.
* Evaluate competing priorities and facilitate tradeoff decisions based on business value, strategic alignment, dependencies, risk, and user impact.
* Maintain a holistic view of the Salesforce ecosystem, ensuring enhancements contribute to cohesive, scalable capabilities rather than isolated point solutions.
* Own product outcomes beyond implementation, including adoption, effectiveness, and continuous improvement.

Salesforce Functional Leadership

* Serve as a Salesforce functional leader with strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, CRM processes, and the capabilities of the broader Salesforce platform.
* Apply an out-of-the-box-first mindset, understanding how Salesforce would typically support an end-to-end business process before determining where Huron-specific capabilities are necessary.
* Envision complete functional solutions across processes, data, automation, reporting, security, integrations, and user experience rather than focusing on individual features.
* Identify gaps between standard Salesforce capabilities and business requirements and partner with architects and engineering teams to evaluate appropriate solutions.
* Remain current on evolving Salesforce capabilities, including Data Cloud/Data 360, Agentforce, automation, analytics, and other capabilities relevant to Business Solutions.

Business Partnership

* Build trusted relationships with Business Solutions leaders and stakeholders and develop a deep understanding of their strategies, processes, challenges, and desired outcomes.
* Lead conversations from the business problem and desired outcome, rather than beginning with a requested technology solution or feature.
* Translate effectively between business and technology teams, creating shared understanding of objectives, requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs.
* Constructively challenge assumptions, distinguish stated requests from underlying needs, and recommend simpler or more effective approaches when appropriate.
* Serve as a trusted advisor who helps leaders understand how Salesforce capabilities can enable, improve, and transform business processes.

Product Discovery & Delivery

* Lead structured discovery for new products, capabilities, enhancements, and business processes.
* Translate complex or ambiguous business needs into clear product capabilities, functional requirements, priorities, and measurable success criteria.
* Partner with Product Owners, Business Analysts, architects, administrators, developers, QA, Data, and business stakeholders throughout the product lifecycle.
* Provide delivery teams with the business context and functional direction necessary to make effective solution decisions while identifying dependencies and downstream impacts early.
* Maintain ownership from discovery through implementation, adoption, feedback, and continuous improvement to ensure delivered capabilities achieve their intended outcomes.

Leadership & People Development

* Lead, coach, and develop product and functional team members, building their product-management, Salesforce, business-analysis, and stakeholder-management capabilities.
* Create clarity, direction, and accountability when teams are navigating ambiguity, competing priorities, or complex business decisions.
* Foster a high-performing culture centered on ownership, collaboration, knowledge sharing, continuous improvement, and business outcomes.
* Influence effectively across organizational boundaries and align teams and leaders who may have different priorities or perspectives.
* Develop future product and functional leaders capable of independently owning business relationships, Salesforce capabilities, and broader product areas.

Required Qualifications

* Significant experience in Salesforce product management, functional consulting, business architecture, CRM product ownership, or a comparable Salesforce-focused role.
* Deep functional understanding of Salesforce, particularly Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud and core CRM processes, with the ability to envision how complete business capabilities can be delivered using standard Salesforce functionality.
* Demonstrated experience translating complex business processes and desired outcomes into product capabilities, functional requirements, and product roadmaps.
* Strong product-management skills across discovery, prioritization, roadmap development, delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated ability to build trusted partnerships with senior business stakeholders and advise, influence, and challenge constructively.
* Strong people leadership experience, including coaching, developing, and leading others.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing stakeholders without relying on direct authority.
* Strong business acumen, analytical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively across both business and technical audiences and translate between the two.

Preferred Qualifications

* Salesforce certifications such as Salesforce Administrator, Advanced Administrator, or Sales Cloud Consultant, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
* Experience with capabilities adjacent to Sales Cloud, such as Data Cloud/Data 360, Agentforce, analytics, automation, integrations, and enterprise data platforms.
* Experience with enterprise-scale CRM implementations or transformation initiatives.
* Experience in professional services or another complex, relationship-driven sales environment.
* Experience working with globally distributed business and technology teams.
* Familiarity with Agile and/or SAFe product-delivery practices.

**Position Level**
------------------

Manager

**Country**
-----------

India

job_description:
**Product Owner**

  

Role Summary

  

Looking for an experienced Product Owner to lead a multi-disciplinary product team delivering value to internal and external clients at Edward Jones. The candidate will own the product roadmap, align strategy to execution, and serve as the primary bridge between business stakeholders and technology teams.

  

Key Responsibilities

  

* Own and manage the product backlog — write, refine, and prioritize user stories aligned to business value

* Define and maintain the product roadmap covering current, near-term, and future delivery

* Collaborate with the Product Manager to translate strategy into actionable delivery plans

* Manage system plans and supporting artefacts — resource needs, dependencies, timelines, milestones, and success criteria

* Act as the voice of the customer within the delivery team and facilitate stakeholder review sessions

* Lead the matrixed product team through influence, mentoring, and coaching

* Align with adjacent product teams to ensure a consistent and cohesive product strategy

* Identify and escalate risks, dependencies, and impediments proactively

  

Skills & Experience Required

  

* 6 to 12 years of experience as a Product Owner or in a related product delivery role

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, MIS, Computer Science, or related field

* Strong understanding of Agile and SAFe delivery frameworks

* Broad knowledge of financial services concepts with emphasis on client onboarding or CRM systems preferred

* Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills

* Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to navigate ambiguity and deliver results

* Experience with JIRA, Confluence, or similar agile tooling

* SAFe POPM certification is advantageous

  

Education

B.Tech/M.Tech/BCA/MCA or equivalent technical education with Bachlelors or Masters degree.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Sr. Product Manager
job_description:
**About us:**  
  
Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Learn more about Target here.  
  
Insert Pyramid & Team Overviews  
  
Product Teams at Target are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all product, technology, discovery and design work.
  
  
The Space Presentation and Transitions data product portfolio provides enterprise-scale data powering how Target plans, optimizes, and evolves physical store space. These products enable business users to design store presentations, understand the financial performance and productivity of space, and strategically plan future transitions and merchandising changes. By integrating data from multiple source domains and delivering it through governed, scalable platforms and self-service capabilities, the team empowers data-driven decision making across space planning, category management, merchandising, and store operations. Product Managers partner with engineers, source system teams, analysts, and business stakeholders to define product strategy, prioritize investments, and deliver reliable data products that create measurable business value and improve the guest experience.  
  
As a Senior Product Manager, you will work in the product model and will partner to develop a comprehensive product strategy, related roadmap, and set key business objectives (OKRs) for your respective product. You will need to leverage the knowledge of your product, as well as customer feedback and establish other relevant data points to assess value, develop business cases, and prioritize the direction and desired outcomes for your product. You will lead a product and work in unison with engineers, UX designers, data scientists and business partners to deliver a product.  
  
You will be the “voice of the product” to key stakeholders to ensure that their needs are met, and that the product team is getting the direction and support that it needs to be successful. You will develop and actively understand the market, maintain a product roadmap and backlog outlining the customer themes, epics, and stories while prioritizing the backlog to focus on the highest impact work for your team and stakeholders.
  
  
You will encourage the open exchange of information and viewpoints, as well as inspire others to achieve challenging goals and high standards of performance while committing to the organization's direction. You will foster a sense of urgency to achieve goals and leverage resources to overcome unexpected obstacles, and partner with product teams across the organization to help them achieve their goals while pursuing and completing yours.
  
  
Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.  
  
**About you:**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience

* 6+ years of product management experience or equivalent domain experience
* Experience with technology and ability to facilitate communication between business and technology teams
* Experience working in an agile environment (e.g., user stories, iterative development, scrum teams, sprints, personas)
* Ability to lead a body of work with cross-functional partners
* Strong communication skills

**Know More About Us here:**

* **Life at Target**: https://india.target.com/
* **Benefits**: https://india.target.com/life-at-target/workplace/benefits
* **Culture**: https://india.target.com/life-at-target/belonging
* **Target** **Tech**: https://tech.target.com/
