title: Staff, AI Product Manager
job_description:
**Job Purpose:**

As the Staff,AI Product Manager, you will be the day-to-day strategic partner for forward deployed engineering (FDE) pods working on a set of high-impact engagements. This is an individual contributor role for someone who can take a complex business problem, structure it, size the value, prototype hands-on, and turn it into something a forward deployed engineer can build against.

You won’t manage engineers — you will be in the room with them, the business sponsor, and the data, translating between all three and keeping each engagement focused on the most valuable outcome.

Forward deployed teams are most powerful when paired with sharp opportunity selection. In this role, you will make sure the engineers we deploy are working on the right things by:

* Sizing value, structuring problems, building concept prototypes, and writing the business cases that fund engagements.
* Acting as the day-to-day strategic counterpart to FDE pods in active deployments.
* Bringing opportunity signals from business sponsors back into the portfolio.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Opportunity identification and value sizing**

* Surface and size AI opportunities across your assigned engagements and adjacent business units, producing one-page opportunity briefs that are easy to compare and prioritise.
* Build credible value cases with finance-grade reasoning behind cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, or cost avoided.
* Develop hands-on domain knowledge of your engagement areas — workflows, data, decisions, and the people who own them.

**Strategic prioritisation and portfolio shaping**

* Recommend what to start, continue, and stop across your engagements based on evidence, not enthusiasm.
* Sequence work for impact, helping engineering leads decide what is in scope this sprint, what comes next, and what is out.

**Engineering partnership and enablement**

* Be the day-to-day strategic partner to FDE pods, converting business ambiguity into crisp problem statements, success metrics, and decision frameworks engineers can act on.
* Run engagement structure end-to-end — scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways — drafted, agreed, and revisited.
* Spot reusable patterns that should become platform capabilities instead of point solutions.

**Stakeholder alignment and communication**

* Work confidently with Director-level business and scientific stakeholders, running working sessions that move things forward and produce decisions, not just notes.
* Maintain sponsor confidence with concise updates, honest risk calls, and clear asks.

**Measurement, learning, and iteration**

* Track value realisation on each engagement against the business case written up front.
* Capture lessons rigorously and feed them back into how the team scopes the next engagement.

**Required Skills:**

* 18+ years of professional experience with bachelor’s or master’s degree or equivalent qualification.
* Candidates with the combination of pharma/life sciences, AI/ML products, product management, or strategy roles in technology-led organisations are preferred.
* A track record of taking complex, ambiguous business problems and turning them into structured, sized opportunities with defensible business cases.
* Strong working knowledge of at least one area of the pharma value chain (such as R&D, supply chain, or commercial), including how decisions actually get made on the ground.
* Technical fluency in modern AI/ML — enough to design realistic engagements with engineers and avoid hype-driven choices.
* Strong individual contributor instincts — you produce quality artefacts, not status updates.

**Preferred Skills**:

* Experience in Global Supply Chain (GSC), particularly Quality and Manufacturing Science & Technology (MSAT).
* Working knowledge of large language models (LLMs), agentic systems, the ML lifecycle, and evaluation patterns, with the ability to assess data readiness (availability, quality, access constraints, and labelling) before engineering starts.
* Understanding of how GxP, regulatory, and data-governance requirements shape AI deployments in pharma — and how to factor them into scoping without over-constraining engineering.
* Experience producing value cases with clear assumptions and sensitivity ranges, and maintaining an opportunity portfolio with clear rationale for what is in flight, queued, or de-prioritised.
* Product intuition: a clear understanding of the difference between an MVP, a product, and a platform, and the ability to spot patterns that should become shared capabilities.
* An AI-native way of working — codifying product management and user research best practices into reusable skills, plugins, and markdown files, and using the command line to automate everyday tasks.
* Ability to lead through influence and write crisp, outcome-focused communications that connect progress to the value case.
* Experience running honest retrospectives that distinguish execution failures from selection failures.

AI Platforms, Artificial Intelligence, Change Management, Data Analysis, Feature Prioritization, Machine Learning (ML), Machine Learning Model Management, ML Platforms, Model Evaluation, Performance Analysis, Product Delivery, Product Design, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Roadmapping, Roadmap Development, Statistical Analysis, User Needs Analysis

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Req ID: 64946

Job Function: Product & Propositions

Posting Start Date: 24/11/2026

Posting End Date: 26/11/2026

Division: Digital

Job Location: IND-Bengaluru-RMZ Ecoworld, IND-Gurugram-IQ

Advertised Salary: Competitive

**Recruiter: Sowmya Reddy**

**Hiring Manager: Franzi Brandenburger**

**Career Grade: D**

**About the role**
------------------

At the heart of our digital transformation there is measurable shift in focus from projects and activities to products and outcomes. The Data Product Owner is key for this shift to happen. A set of empowered individuals living and breathing the ideation, definition and delivery of data products, services and solutions for our customers and wider business.

Working to support the Solution Delivery Lead for Service, you will partner with the CFU’s (Business & International) to capture and manage demand. Prioritise demands in the units based on speed and value. You will also define the execution model required to deliver best in class solutions for the business.
  

* Embed -> Resource provisioning
* Partner -> Squad provisioning
* Enable -> Direct outcome delivery

  

Key Responsibilities:
  

* Manages and qualifies the demand with the other functions in Data / Digital
* Manages the delivered products in their entire lifecycle (working with the other functions)
* Works with the rest of the units, CFUs and Business Operations to properly interlock cost and value
* Agree / interlock an adoption strategy
* Manges the delivery of use cases and the necessary data/telemetry for the Domain across the units.

You will leverage your deep understanding of data, industry best practices, your business values coupled with strong agile and technical delivery practices to deliver best in class solutions for our customers that drive value to BT’s bottom line.

  

Key responsibilities of the role
  

* Product delivery and iteration planning
* Create, maintain and regularly iterate a roadmap and backlog for your squad.
* Definition and monitoring of product performance indicators
* Leading the squad responsible for product delivery of the owned products
* Input in the demand management process in terms of classification/qualification/resourcing of the demand, working with the Solution Leads.
* A customer-centric Approach: Focus on user needs and preferences. By understanding and prioritizing customer requirements, the Data Product Owner will ensure that data products meet user expectations and deliver value. This customer-centric approach is essential for creating products that resonate with users and drive user satisfaction.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

* **Understanding business needs:** deeply understand the organization's goals, challenges, and opportunities, aligning data strategies with overarching business objectives to positively drive growth transformation across the business.
* **Translation and Communication:** translate complex technical concepts into understandable language for non-technical stakeholders. Effective communication ensures that business leaders and decision-makers comprehend the value and implications of data solutions.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Building strong relationships with business CFU’s, Digital departments, and teams is a key aspect of this role. True partnering and collaboration with stakeholders to identify their specific needs and requirements, but also to trigger and generate new ideas/opportunities, supported by the other capability teams and the area Solutions Leads.
* **ROI Assessment and tracking coordination:** Assess the return on investment (ROI) for data initiatives, helping organizations make informed decisions about resource allocation and project prioritization.
* **Change Management:** Implementing data solutions often involves organizational changes. This role helps manage these changes, working with the change teams and Product Owners and Solutions Leads, including training and support for employees adapting to new technologies and workflows.
* **Strategic Planning:** Contributing to the development of data strategies, ensuring they align with the broader business strategy and long-term vision.
* **Continuous Improvement:** The role involves monitoring the performance of data solutions, identifying areas for improvement, and adjusting to maximize their impact on the business.
* **Collaborate** closely with engineering, design, data science, and other cross-functional teams to define data product requirements, prioritize features, and ensure timely and successful product delivery.
* **Serve as a subject matter expert** across a range data-led solution management activities providing guidance and support to internal stakeholders, customers, and partners.
* Define and track key solutions metrics to measure product performance and success, using data insights to drive decision-making and optimize product features.
* Works closely with and manages stakeholder priorities, aligning needs with resources ensuring cadence with customer value, business value, and strategic fit.
* Articulates formal and detailed business case projections ahead of new functionality releases and continued monitoring after release.

**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* **Leadership:** Leadership skills help in influencing and guiding teams and stakeholders toward common goals and objectives.
* **Business Acumen:** A deep understanding of the organization's industry, business model and goals is a must for this role. Strong commercial acumen is also required to assess business benefits/realisation mapping Data initiatives to the company's strategic objectives.
* **Data Literacy:** Proficiency in understanding and interpreting data. This includes the ability to grasp data concepts, recognize patterns, and understand the implications of data analysis on business decisions.
* **Technical Knowledge:** A foundational understanding of data technologies, tools, and methodologies is important. While not necessarily hands-on, this knowledge helps in effective communication and decision-making.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:** Building and maintaining relationships with various stakeholders, including business leaders, data scientists, and IT professionals. This involves active listening and understanding diverse perspectives.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent communication skills are vital for translating complex technical information into business terms. This role must convey the value and impact of data initiatives to non-technical stakeholders.
* **Project Management:** Strong project management skills enable the Lead to oversee and coordinate data projects, ensuring they stay on track, meet deadlines, and align with business objectives.
* **ROI Assessment:** The ability to evaluate the return on investment for data projects is crucial for prioritizing initiatives that provide the most significant business value.
* **Strategic Thinking:** The ability to think strategically and align data initiatives with long-term business goals is a critical skill for driving sustainable impact.
* **Analytical Thinking:** Analytical skills help in evaluating the potential impact of data projects on business outcomes and in making data-driven decisions.
* **Conflict Resolution:** Being able to address conflicts and resolve issues that may arise between different stakeholders or within project teams.
* **Adaptability:** The ability to adapt to changing business conditions and evolving technologies is important in the rapidly evolving field of data and AI.

BT is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.

  

BT ’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.

  

Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best.

  

We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

Job Opening: Regulatory Affairs Officer

**Bionova Research Labs Pvt. Ltd. – Bengaluru**

**Location:** Yelachenahalli, Bengaluru  
**Experience:** 5–10 Years  
**Industry:** Pharmaceuticals & Nutraceuticals  
**Qualification:** B.Pharm / M.Pharm / M.Sc. or relevant qualification

**Key Responsibilities**

* Independently handle FSSAI and Drugs & Cosmetics regulatory compliance.
* Manage FSSAI, Drug Control and CDSCO licensing, approvals, renewals and statutory submissions, as applicable.
* Review pharmaceutical and nutraceutical formulations for regulatory compliance.
* Verify ingredient permissibility, dosage limits, product classification and claims.
* Approve packaging artwork, labels, promotional materials and advertisements.
* Handle regulatory inspections, notices, queries and corrective actions.
* Maintain regulatory documentation, compliance trackers and monthly MIS.
* Coordinate with R&D, QA/QC, Production and Marketing teams.
* Monitor regulatory amendments and ensure timely implementation.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Strong hands-on experience in BOTH FSSAI and pharmaceutical regulatory affairs is mandatory.
* Extensive experience working in pharmaceutical and nutraceutical manufacturing companies.
* Practical knowledge of FoSCoS, Drugs & Cosmetics regulations, labelling and product approvals.
* Experience dealing independently with FSSAI and Drug Control authorities.
* Ability to assess formulations and approve regulatory compliance without external dependency.

**Preferred:** Candidates experienced in third-party manufacturing, new product development and regulatory audits.

**Reporting To:** Head – Legal, Regulatory Affairs & Corporate Governance

**Working Days:** Monday–Saturday  
**Timings:** 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM

**Important:** Candidates experienced in only FSSAI or only pharmaceutical regulatory affairs will not be considered.

Pay: ₹535,000.00 - ₹650,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Product Manager - Cogentiq CX
job_description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!

*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*

**About Cogentiq CX**
---------------------

Cogentiq CX is Fractal’s enterprise contact center AI platform, purpose-built for regulated industries such as Banking, Insurance, and Healthcare. It combines voice and chat automation, agent assist, and agentic AI workflows to help enterprises resolve customer interactions faster without compromising compliance, security, or customer trust.

### **The Role**

We’re looking for a Product Manager to own the roadmap and delivery of key capabilities across Cogentiq CX’s voice, chat, and agentic AI stack. You’ll work with engineering, AI/ML, solutions, sales, and customer success to turn customer problems into products that run in production in demanding enterprise contact centers.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for voice and chat automation and agentic AI capabilities
* Translate enterprise customer needs, pilot learnings, and market signals into clear PRDs, user stories, and prioritized backlogs
* Drive design of agentic experiences: orchestration, tool and API integration, guardrails, escalation to human agents, and evaluation frameworks
* Define success metrics (containment, resolution rate, AHT, CSAT, latency, hallucination and compliance rates) and use them to guide iteration
* Partner with engineering and AI teams on architecture trade-offs across ASR/TTS, LLMs, telephony, and CCaaS integrations
* Work with pre-sales, FDEs, and customer success on pilots, POCs, and RFx responses, and carry the learnings back into the product
* Support go-to-market with positioning, demos, sales enablement, and analyst/partner conversations
* Track the competitive landscape (CCaaS vendors, conversational AI platforms, voice AI startups) and sharpen differentiation
* Ensure products meet the security, privacy, and compliance expectations of regulated industries

### **What You Bring**

**Must have**

* 7+ years in product management, with 3+ years on contact center, conversational AI, or CX products
* Hands-on experience shipping voice and/or chat products (IVR modernization, voicebots, chatbots, virtual agents, agent assist)
* Working knowledge of agentic AI: LLM-based agents, tool use, RAG, orchestration, prompt design, and evaluation and guardrails
* Familiarity with the contact center ecosystem: CCaaS platforms (Genesys, NICE, Five9, Amazon Connect, Avaya, etc.), telephony/SIP, CRM and ticketing integrations
* Experience with enterprise B2B products, including long sales cycles, pilots-to-production, and complex stakeholder environments
* Strong analytical skills and comfort with metrics, experimentation, and data-driven prioritization
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to engage both technical teams and C-level buyers

**Good to have**

* Prior experience with regulated industries (BFSI, healthcare) and related compliance requirements (PCI-DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, data residency)
* Background in classical NLP/NLU (intent and entity models, dialog management) and experience through the shift to GenAI
* Experience with real-time voice challenges: latency, barge-in, turn-taking, multilingual and accent handling
* Exposure to observability, QA, and analytics tooling for conversational systems
* Technical background (engineering or data science) or comfort reading API docs and reviewing architecture
* Experience with partner and marketplace integrations

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Not the right fit? Let us know you're interested in a future opportunity by clicking *Introduce Yourself* in the top-right corner of the page or create an account to set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

title: Agile Product Owner
job_description:
About Vista Equity Partners

Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100 billion in assets under management and a portfolio of more than 90 software companies worldwide, Vista supports growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership.

Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is helping its portfolio companies apply generative AI responsibly across products, operations, and decision-making. Vista also supports learning and development through portfolio-wide programs, leadership workshops, and AI initiatives.

About Amtech

Amtech provides enterprise software for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems support order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics, helping customers improve efficiency and operational performance.

With Vista’s investment and strategic guidance, Amtech combines the agility of a growing technology organization with the stability and career opportunities of a global software ecosystem.

Our Employee Value Proposition

At Amtech, you can:

* **Make an impact:** Help shape manufacturing and supply chain operations through mission-critical enterprise software.
* **Keep growing:** Access learning, leadership development, and opportunities across Vista’s global network.
* **Work collaboratively:** Join a transparent, people-first culture grounded in accountability and integrity.
* **Contribute to innovation:** Help modernize business processes and explore technologies such as AI-driven automation.

Role Overview

We are hiring Product Owners at the **Product Owner II and Senior Product Owner levels** to support product execution across Amtech’s labeling and corrugated ERP platforms, with a focus on automated scheduling applications.

Depending on experience and scope, the role may focus on owning the scheduling product backlog or performing product-management execution for the labeling product line while coordinating and supporting the product-owner community across both product lines.

In either focus, you will work with product management, engineering, QA, UX, architecture, and customer-facing teams to turn roadmap initiatives and manufacturing needs into clear development work and useful product outcomes.

The Senior Product Owner focus includes coordinating agile planning and ceremonies, supporting product owners, and maintaining quality standards for product development lifecycle (PDLC) artifacts. This is a coordination and enablement role and does not carry direct people-management responsibility. Market-facing direction, priorities, and customer strategy are set in partnership with in-market product leadership.

Key ResponsibilitiesProduct Ownership and Execution

* Own or support the product backlog for automated scheduling applications and related labeling or corrugated ERP capabilities.
* Work with Product Managers and in-market product leadership to translate roadmap initiatives into epics, user stories, and actionable backlog items.
* Define and prioritize features, enhancements, and fixes based on customer needs, product direction, and business goals.
* Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and ensure items are ready for sprint planning.
* Work with tech leads and development teams to plan delivery across multiple sprints and longer-term initiatives.
* Maintain product artifacts and, at the Senior Product Owner level, review PDLC artifacts for completeness and quality.

Manufacturing and Customer Insight

* Engage with customers, customer support, implementation, and services teams to understand manufacturing workflows and scheduling challenges.
* Translate production scheduling and manufacturing requirements into scalable product capabilities.
* Help resolve software defects and define customer-specific features in collaboration with product management.
* Ensure product decisions reflect customer needs and support broader product goals.

Agile Delivery and Coordination

* Work closely with engineering, QA, UX, and architecture teams during planning, development, and release cycles.
* Coordinate with Product Managers, tech leads, and development teams in Program Increment (PI) planning.
* Participate in or facilitate sprint planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other agile ceremonies.
* Clarify requirements and help teams understand the intended product outcomes.
* At the Senior Product Owner level, coordinate and support product owners across the India-based labeling and corrugated teams, and help build shared practices through a community of practice.

Product Delivery and Continuous Improvement

* Validate delivered functionality against acceptance criteria and business objectives.
* Support product releases through documentation, training, and internal enablement.
* Provide product expertise to internal stakeholders and contribute to continuous improvement of scheduling capabilities and product-owner practices.

Skills and Qualifications

* **Product Owner II:** Typically 3–5+ years of experience as a Product Owner or in a similar software product role.
* **Senior Product Owner:** Typically 7+ years of experience in product ownership, product management, or business analysis, including experience coordinating or supporting other Product Owners.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum software development environments.
* Experience managing product backlogs, writing user stories, and defining requirements.
* Experience with ERP systems and the ability to translate business needs into technical product specifications.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including experience working with distributed teams.
* For the Senior Product Owner focus, experience facilitating agile ceremonies, including PI planning, and establishing or maintaining standards for product artifacts.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with manufacturing, production scheduling, scheduling optimization, or ERP applications.
* Knowledge of production operations, shop-floor workflows, or manufacturing analytics.
* Experience with ERP integrations and manufacturing workflows.
* Experience working with in-market product leadership in a distributed or offshore delivery model.
* Experience coaching or supporting other Product Owners or building a community of practice.
* Familiarity with Jira or similar backlog-management tools.

Why Join Amtech

At Amtech, you’ll help deliver software that supports real manufacturing operations while benefiting from Vista’s global ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented teams, access cross-portfolio learning opportunities, and contribute to the continued development of Amtech’s ERP and scheduling products.

Pay: ₹1,600,000.00 - ₹3,500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Experience:

* Manufacturing: 1 year (Required)
* ERP/ Enterprise Software : 1 year (Required)
* 0-1 Product Ownership: 1 year (Required)
* Agile product development: 1 year (Required)
* Back logs: 1 year (Preferred)
* Shop-Floor: 1 year (Preferred)

Location:

* Bengaluru, Karnataka (Preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bengaluru, Karnataka

title: Associate Product Manager
job_description:
**Your Job**

As an **Associate Product Manager**, you will help grow the cable assembly business by managing existing business and advancing new Emerging and Focused Customer opportunities through product development and production launch. You will connect commercial, technical, and operational teams to develop profitable solutions, successfully launch programs, and drive long-term customer and business value.

**Our Team**

You will be part of the **CCS PSBU Product Management** team in Bangalore, working closely with Sales, Business Development, Engineering, Costing, Sourcing, Planning, Purchasing, NPD, and Operations. The team collaborates across functions to develop and launch profitable cable assembly solutions for customers.

**What You Will Do**

  

* Drive revenue, profitability, and market-share growth for the Emerging and Focused Customer cable assembly business.
* Manage new cable assembly opportunities through the middle and later stages of the product development process, from requirements validation and costing through qualification, production readiness, and launch.
* Lead costing, quotation, and profitable pricing activities while ensuring customer requirements, Bill of Materials (BOM), feasibility inputs, and commercial assumptions are complete and aligned.
* Develop and drive program plans covering scope, schedules, risks, milestones, and success criteria, and lead cross-functional teams in resolving barriers to execution.
* Partner with Sales, Engineering, Sourcing, Planning, Purchasing, NPD, and Operations to ensure manufacturing readiness and smooth production ramp-up.
* Build strong relationships with customers, Sales, and distribution partners while serving as a key interface for technical and commercial discussions.
* Drive profitability of existing business through cost-variance improvements, capacity planning, quality improvements, and targeted cost-reduction opportunities.
* Monitor program performance, customer commitments, opportunity conversion, and product-development milestones, ensuring accurate records and effective stakeholder communication.

  
**Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)**  

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering.
* **10+ years of experience in Sales & Marketing and/or Product Management within the electromechanical device industry.**
* Experience supporting **product costing, quotation, pricing, or commercial activities** for engineered products.
* Experience working cross-functionally with commercial, engineering, and manufacturing/operations teams.
* Fluent written and spoken English with proficiency in word processing, spreadsheets, and presentation applications.

  
**What Will Put You Ahead**  

* Experience in the **cable assembly, connector, or interconnect industry**.
* Experience managing products or customer programs through **product development and production-launch lifecycles**.
* Experience with **SAP** or similar enterprise resource planning systems.
* Experience engaging customers and Sales teams in technical discussions related to cable assemblies.
* Demonstrated experience with cost reduction, profitability improvement, capacity planning, or manufacturing-readiness initiatives.

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

**Who We Are**

At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

title: Engineering Product Manager
job_description:
Meet the Team
  
  
Join the Webex CX Product Management team to help shape the capabilities of our new Dialog product for long-duration AI engagements that resolve customer needs. Translate customer evidence into priorities and requirements, and partner with engineering and others to deliver compelling customer experiences that power the future of CX.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  

* Deliver on the Dialog product direction and AI roadmap
* Execute on the near-term Dialog roadmap, aligned with broader strategy and a focused on a 6-12 month horizon.
* Translate customer needs, workflow problems, and technical constraints into clear product outcomes, requirements, and priorities.
* Set requirements and success measures for a harness that enables long-duration AI engagements to resolve customer needs; surface key dependencies.
* Guide Customer and Evidence-Based Decisions
* Synthesize customer, field, support, usage, quality, and market input to identify needs and guide product decisions.
* Validate product and engagement concepts with customers and partners; refine problem statements and priorities with evidence.
* Analyze usage, feedback, dependencies, and product performance to find pain points and to drive product improvements.
* Use customer outcomes and quality data to measure results and guide product priorities and investment.
* Explain tradeoffs among customer value, product quality, complexity, and delivery capacity.
* Build and Iterate AI Product Capabilities
* Partner with engineering, design, and AI teams to specify, assess, and deliver Dialog core capabilities.
* Use short delivery cycles; assess readiness, surface risks, and adjust plans as evidence and technical learning evolve.
* Coordinate discovery, launch, and iteration with go-to-market, customer success, support, and operations.
* Track adoption, engagement quality, and customer impact; use results to guide iteration and priorities.
* Deliver with Agility Across Teams
* Adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment while maintaining clear decisions, reliable execution, and customer focus.
* Align cross-functional partners on requirements, ownership, dependencies, and sequencing; build shared understanding without direct authority.
* Communicate progress, tradeoffs, and risks; escalate issues that need broader decisions.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's degree and 5 years of related experience; or Master's degree and 3 years; or PhD and 0 years of related experience, consistent with applicable Cisco hiring guidelines.
* Experience in product management, product development, or product lifecycle management for enterprise software, SaaS, communications, or AI-enabled customer products.
* Experience translating customer problems and business needs into product requirements, prioritized plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Working knowledge of AI-enabled software and a technical discipline relevant to product work with engineering teams.
* Ability to analyze customer feedback, product usage, product dependencies, and quality data to develop prioritization recommendations.
* Ability to collaborate with engineering, design, and cross-functional partners and communicate product rationale, progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly.
* Ability to adapt to changing information and priorities, make timely decisions, and deliver effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience taking product concepts from discovery through iterative delivery and assessing results against customer and product measures.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience with conversational AI, contact center or customer experience software, and AI engagements that span extended customer interactions.
* Demonstrated ability to perform in a startup or similarly fast-moving product environment, adapting plans as customer needs and product learning evolve.
* Experience with AI-enabled product development, including using AI tools to support product discovery, prototyping, evaluation, or execution.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other thanhttps://careers.cisco.com orcisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

* Use customer outcomes and quality data to measure results and guide product priorities and investment.
* Explain tradeoffs among customer value, product quality, complexity, and delivery capacity.
* Build and Iterate AI Product Capabilities
* Partner with engineering, design, and AI teams to specify, assess, and deliver Dialog core capabilities.
* Use short delivery cycles; assess readiness, surface risks, and adjust plans as evidence and technical learning evolve.
* Coordinate discovery, launch, and iteration with go-to-market, customer success, support, and operations.
* Track adoption, engagement quality, and customer impact; use results to guide iteration and priorities.
* Deliver with Agility Across Teams
* Adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment while maintaining clear decisions, reliable execution, and customer focus.
* Align cross-functional partners on requirements, ownership, dependencies, and sequencing; build shared understanding without direct authority.
* Communicate progress, tradeoffs, and risks; escalate issues that need broader decisions.

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's degree and 5 years of related experience; or Master's degree and 3 years; or PhD and 0 years of related experience, consistent with applicable Cisco hiring guidelines.
* Experience in product management, product development, or product lifecycle management for enterprise software, SaaS, communications, or AI-enabled customer products.
* Experience translating customer problems and business needs into product requirements, prioritized plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Working knowledge of AI-enabled software and a technical discipline relevant to product work with engineering teams.
* Ability to analyze customer feedback, product usage, product dependencies, and quality data to develop prioritization recommendations.
* Ability to collaborate with engineering, design, and cross-functional partners and communicate product rationale, progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly.
* Ability to adapt to changing information and priorities, make timely decisions, and deliver effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience taking product concepts from discovery through iterative delivery and assessing results against customer and product measures.

Preferred Qualifications
  
  

* Experience with conversational AI, contact center or customer experience software, and AI engagements that span extended customer interactions.
* Demonstrated ability to perform in a startup or similarly fast-moving product environment, adapting plans as customer needs and product learning evolve.
* Experience with AI-enabled product development, including using AI tools to support product discovery, prototyping, evaluation, or execution.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Shopify Product Manager
job_description:
We’re looking for a proactive, curious, and detail-oriented **Shopify Product Manager** (6 months – 2 years of experience) with a blend of **communication and tech skills** to join our team in South Delhi.

Prior experience **managing Shopify apps** or a strong grasp of the **Shopify ecosystem** is essential for this role. You will take end-to-end product ownership of our agency’s in-house Shopify apps—driving the roadmap, feature rollouts, and merchant adoption—while also supporting client e-commerce builds.

**What You’ll Do:**

* **Shopify App:** Manage our in-house Shopify apps—handling feature planning, merchant feedback, app updates, and overall growth from concept to execution.
* **Hands-On Shopify Execution:** Oversee Shopify store setups, theme customizations, third-party app integrations, checkout flows, and basic Liquid/HTML troubleshooting across agency projects.
* **Comms-to-Tech Translation:** Act as the bridge between merchants/clients and internal developers—translating business requirements into clear product specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* **Product Strategy & Backlog:** Define product direction for both our internal apps and client platforms, prioritizing features based on impact and user needs while keeping the backlog organized.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work closely with our design, tech, and strategy teams to take Shopify apps, websites, and digital products from concept to launch.
* **Testing, QA & Launches:** Run thorough quality checks and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) before app updates or storefronts go live—we like things clean and polished!
* **Data & Iteration:** Track app and storefront KPIs, analyze merchant/user behaviour, and iterate based on real performance data.
* **Trend Spotting:** Stay on top of changes in the Shopify App Store ecosystem, e-commerce tools, and digital media.

**About the role:**

* **Experience**: 6 months – 2 years in product management, Shopify app management, SaaS/apps, or e-commerce.
* **Location**: On-site, East of Kailash, South Delhi
* **Working Days & Timings:** Monday – Saturday, 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM
* **Remuneration**: INR 20k-50k per month (potential for more based on experience)
* **Joining**: Immediate joiners preferred.

**What We’re Looking For:**

* **Shopify App Management Experience (Required):** Prior hands-on experience managing, building, or working directly on **Shopify apps** (understanding app lifecycles, merchant onboarding, feature releases, and Shopify App Store workflows). OR
* **Shopify Ecosystem Knowledge (Required):** Solid working familiarity with Shopify storefronts, themes, third-party apps, and e-commerce best practices.
* **Proactiveness & Eagerness to Learn:** A self-starter attitude with a strong willingness to figure things out, ask the right questions, and quickly pick up any tools or technical nuances you might not already know.
* **Comms + Tech Mindset:** Strong written and verbal communication skills paired with a genuine curiosity for how digital products and apps are built, tested, and scaled.
* **Organization & Ownership:** You thrive on owning a product end-to-end—keeping timelines, developers, and deliverables on track without letting details slip.
* **Tool Proficiency:** Comfortable using tools like Google Docs, Trello, and Notion (or quick to pick them up).

Job Types: Full-time, Fresher

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Ability to commute/relocate:

* South Delhi, Delhi, Delhi: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Application Question(s):

* Do you have 6 months of experience in project management?
* Are you an Immediate joiner?
* Do you acknowledge that this role is going to have a 6-month probation period with a base pay range of 15k-20k per month?

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
title: Assistant Product Manager
job_description:
**Job Title: Assistant Product Manager**

**About SEEDS**

Sustainable Environment and Ecological Development Society (SEEDS) is a leading non-profit organization working towards making communities resilient to the impact of disaster risks through various innovative approaches, working in disaster management for over 30 years. As you may be aware, SEEDS has been awarded the Sasakawa Award for Disaster Risk Reduction 2022 by the United Nations and the most prestigious Subhash Chandra Bose Aapda Prabandhan Puraskar 2021 by the Hon’ble Prime Minister of India. It continues to empower the most vulnerable across Asia to build a better future. For more information, visit www.seedsindia.org

Role Purpose

Support the Product Manager in implementing, enhancing and maintaining organizational technology platforms, translating approved business requirements into functional deliverables, coordinating technology development partners, and ensuring effective testing, deployment and user adoption.

Scope of Work

1. **Technology platform implementation:** Support the implementation, enhancement and maintenance of ERP, CRM and other organizational digital platforms.

2. **Requirements and documentation:** Work with the Product Manager and internal stakeholders to gather requirements and prepare functional requirement documents (FRDs), workflows, process maps and technical documentation.

3. **New technology partner onboarding:** Identify and assess prospective technology development partners; coordinate technical discussions, proposal evaluations, scope finalization, contractual processes and project kick-off activities.

4. **Development partner coordination:** Coordinate with existing and new partners on development, testing, deployment, timelines, deliverables and maintenance.

5. **Product development support:** Translate approved BRDs and solution designs into functional requirements, development tasks and implementation plans in coordination with the Product Manager.

6. **Testing and quality assurance:** Coordinate UAT, maintain bug and issue trackers, document feedback and follow up with development partners until resolution.

7. **Process improvement and automation:** Identify operational gaps and recommend technology-driven improvements, including AI-based solutions and workflow automation.

8. **Dashboards and reporting:** Develop and maintain dashboards, reports and automation using Advanced Excel and other digital tools.

9. **Technology research:** Research and evaluate emerging technologies, AI solutions and digital platforms for organizational use.

10. **Training and documentation:** Prepare SOPs, user manuals and training materials, and conduct user training sessions.

11. **Platform monitoring:** Monitor platform performance, track implementation progress, maintain project trackers and recommend continuous improvements.

12. **Cross-functional coordination:** Coordinate with internal departments and external partners to support timely delivery of digital initiatives.

13. **System integration and data management:** Support system integrations, data management and digital transformation initiatives across the organization.

14. **Technical support:** Troubleshoot user issues and coordinate resolution with technology partners.

Pay: ₹781,000.00 - ₹1,030,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
title: Associate Product Owner
job_description:
Location: Noida Berger Tower, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India’s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Set priorities and outcomes (6‑week cadence)**: align **Product**, **Engineering**, and **Architecture** on **cycle objectives** and measurable OKRs/KPIs (adoption, reliability, security posture, cost/performance). Collaborate with **Security**, **Compliance**, and **Operations** to balance customer value with **security risk**, readiness, and constraints; and bring clear options/trade‑offs to **Planning Day** (scope, dependencies, capacity).
* **Partner with discovery/exploration (intake + feedback loop)**: collaborate with **PM**, **UX**, **Architecture**, and **Security** during **Continuous Exploration (CE)** to clarify the problem, define success metrics, and shape solution options. Align early with **Engineering** and **Operations** on implementation approach, operability, and rollout constraints; and ensure hand‑offs include decisions, assumptions, and acceptance criteria. Feed production learnings back into exploration (usability, risk signals, cost/performance).
* **Own the delivery backlog**: maintain and prioritize the backlog in partnership with **Engineering** and **Architecture**, balancing value, risk, and dependencies. Collaborate with **Security/Compliance** to embed policy and audit needs, and with **Operations** to capture reliability/observability requirements. Keep scope, acceptance criteria, and **NFRs** clear, and ensure items are implementation‑ready before commitment.
* **Refine for Planning Day and execution**: run collaborative refinement with **Engineering**, **Architecture**, **Security**, and **UX** to break down work into executable stories. Agree acceptance criteria and edge cases, capture **NFRs** (security, privacy, performance, reliability, auditability), and align on test strategy. Maintain a lightweight **dependency/risk register** with partner teams and secure timely decisions before committing.
* **Enable predictable delivery and adoption**: collaborate with **Dev Managers** and the squad(s) to set clear iteration goals, manage trade‑offs, and adjust scope through **mid‑cycle checkpoints**. Coordinate with **Operations** and **Security** on **release readiness** (runbooks, monitoring, access, incident playbooks) and drive **release planning** and **progressive rollout** with measurable success criteria. Ensure end‑of‑cycle **demos**/**retrospectives** convert into backlog and process improvements.
* **Champion the AI‑First SDLC (secure + responsible)**: drive shared adoption of AI‑assisted ways of working with **Product** and **Engineering** (refinement, test ideation, defect triage, incident learnings, release notes) while maintaining **human accountability**. Co‑define tool/data guardrails with **Architecture**, **Security**, and **Compliance**; validate AI outputs; and embed **automated quality/security gates** across build and release. Ensure SDLC artifacts (PRDs, designs, threat models) are complete and reviewable.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* **Experience**: 5+ years as Product Owner / Product Manager / Business Analyst in software delivery; experience in **IAM, cybersecurity, or platform products** preferred.
* **AI literacy (required)**: strong hands‑on use of AI assistants in product + SDLC work (discovery, story writing, test ideation, review) with **human accountability**. You will apply Thales’ GenAI principles: **CONFIDENTIALITY**, **QUALITY**, **RESPONSIBILITY**, and **BIAS ELIMINATION** (e.g., protect sensitive data, validate outputs, ensure independent review, avoid circular validation).
* **Leadership & communication**: influence without authority; align stakeholders; model **Leadership@Thales** (Imagine the Future, Inspire to Engage, Deliver User‑Centric Solutions, Act with Agility, Grow Others & Self, Include Others).

**Preferred Skills and Experience**
-----------------------------------

* **AI‑enabled product delivery tooling**: experience with tools such as Jira/Aha!/Craft.io and AI‑assisted workflows that improve refinement, traceability, and delivery speed.
* **IAM platform mindset**: experience with APIs and architecture collaboration; understanding of IAM journeys (registration, login, MFA, recovery, admin) and operability (monitoring, incident response, audit).

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Technical Product Manager - AI Platforms, Director
job_description:
Closing date for applications: 04/12/2026

Location Gurugram, India

Job typePermanent | Contract typeFull Time

#R-00288180

  

**Join our digital revolution in NatWest Digital X**
----------------------------------------------------

In everything we do, we work to one aim. To make digital experiences which are effortless and secure.

So we organise ourselves around three principles: engineer, protect, and operate. We engineer simple solutions, we protect our customers, and we operate smarter.

**Job description**
-------------------

This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.

Join us as a Technical Product Manager - AI Platform

  
  

* You’ll be responsible for managing the development and implementation of technology-driven products
* The role focuses on understanding customer needs, overseeing the product lifecycle, and collaborating with technical and non-technical teams to ensure successful product delivery that aligns with business objectives
* You’ll gain valuable senior stakeholder exposure as well as the opportunity to hone your technical talents and leadership skills
* We're offering this role at director level
  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  

We’ll look to you to drive the end-to-end lifecycle of technology products, from roadmap ownership and feature prioritization to launch and post-release evaluation. You’ll ensure strategic alignment through clear documentation and effective stakeholder communication, while proactively managing risks and fostering cross-functional collaboration.

  
  

You’ll also provide technical guidance to engineering teams, articulate customer pain points, and define performance metrics to measure success. We’ll also look to you to lead and mentor team members, supporting hiring efforts, and enabling agile decision-making to maintain momentum and
  
deliver impactful, customer-centric solutions.

  
  

Additionally, you’ll be:

  
  

* Delivering a product roadmap that aligns with business objectives and technological advancements
* Ensuring effective communication between technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Leading the product development lifecycle from concept to delivery with a high-performing engineering team
* Making data-driven decisions that improve product performance and user satisfaction
* Providing regular reporting on product performance, development progress, and market trends
  

  

**The skills you'll need**
--------------------------

  
  

We’re on the lookout for a strategic thinker with a passion for technology and innovation. You’ll have extensive experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field with strong leadership abilities, capable of motivating and influencing cross-functional teams.You’ll need at least seventeen years of total experience, with strong expertise in setting product vision, defining product strategy and roadmaps, and aligning development with strategic outcomes.

  
  

You’ll bring extensive experience in designing large-scale cloud architectures and distributed systems across AWS, GCP, and Azure, along with deep expertise in GenAI platform architecture, agentic systems, cloud-native technologies, and hands-on platform engineering. You’ll also be experienced in creating financial forecasts for products and features, contributing to platform-level budgeting, and driving focus and efficiency through disciplined prioritisation and agile decision-making.

  
  

You’ll also have:

  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Proficiency in project management tools and Agile or Scrum methodologies
* Familiarity with software development processes and technologies
* The ability to work in a fast-paced environment

**Welcome to our Gurugram hub**
-------------------------------

Spanning 437,000 sq. ft., our campus in Gurugram features two state-of-the-art towers – 1A and 2A at the Candor TechSpace in Sector 21.

### **Key facts:**

* Surrounded by 28 acres
* Space for 4,100 colleagues
* Opened in 2010

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
Position: Senior Product Manager

Location: Mumbai

Working Days: Monday to Friday

Experience Required: 7+ years

**Senior Product Manager**
==========================

**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS**

the client powers some of India's biggest live event on-sales. As we grow, the consumer app needs one senior owner who ties discovery, buying and retention into a single product. You'll set the direction for the app, lead a team of product managers and ship with design and engineering. Expect high ownership, quick decisions and short paths to users.

**WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO**

App and Discovery

* Own the homepage and app experience, so every visit reflects who the user is and what's next for them
* Build personalised discovery, from playful onboarding to recommendations people act on
* Work with the Shadow lead on how our AI agent fits into the app

Transactions and Growth

* Make the buy flow (event page, seat maps, checkout, referral) faster and more reliable on every device
* Own downloads, retention, engagement and loyalty, with metrics you set and report on

Team & Collaboration

* Lead and grow a team of product managers
* Partner with design, engineering and marketing across Mumbai and Bangalore

**WHAT YOU BRING**

*Specific experience, not vague credentials*

Required

* 7+ years in product, with at least 3 owning a consumer app end to end
* Built consumer apps at scale in India
* Owned a checkout or buy flow where conversion and reliability both mattered
* Moved retention or engagement, and can explain what worked and what didn't
* Managed product managers or APMs

Preferred

* Experience in live events, ticketing, entertainment, travel or a similar consumer category
* Shipped an AI or conversational product to real users
* Personalisation or recommendations work: onboarding, user profiles, ranked feeds
* Campaign-led app experiences built with marketing

**NON-NEGOTIABLES**

You've owned a consumer app's numbers, not just its features. This role is judged on retention and conversion, not output.

You've led product managers. You'll run a team from day one, with no time to learn people management on the job.

You write clearly. Specs and decisions move between two cities; if they need a call to be understood, work stalls.

You take direction and push back with evidence. You'll work closely with a strong design lead, as a partner rather than an order-taker.

You're based in Mumbai and can travel to Bangalore regularly. The team works across both cities.

title: Product Manager
job_description:
**Job Opening with NBFC**

Location: **Powai**

Designation: **Product Manager**

Budget: **Upto 8 LPA (Depends upon experience and skills)**

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a results-driven Product Manager with experience in the NBFC or banking sector to lead the development and enhancement of financial products. The ideal candidate will own the product lifecycle, from ideation to execution, and work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver customer-centric and compliant solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Own end-to-end product lifecycle: ideation, requirement gathering, development, launch, and optimization

· Define product vision, roadmap, and strategy aligned with business goals

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

· 4–7 years of product management experience in NBFC, banking, or fintech

· Strong understanding of financial products (loans, credit cards, payments, deposits, etc.)

· Experience working on digital platforms (mobile apps, web platforms, APIs)

· Familiarity with regulatory frameworks (RBI, KYC, AML compliance)

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

· Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies

· Ability to work with stakeholders across business, tech, and operations

· Excellent communication and documentation skills

· Collaborate with engineering, design, risk, compliance, and operations teams

· Drive digital product initiatives such as lending platforms, payments, onboarding, or financial services apps

· Analyze customer needs, market trends, and competitor offerings to identify opportunities

· Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements (RBI guidelines, KYC, AML, etc.)

· Create PRDs (Product Requirement Documents), user stories, and acceptance criteria

· Monitor product performance using KPIs such as conversion rates, customer acquisition, retention, and revenue

· Lead product launches and coordinate go-to-market strategies

· Continuously improve user experience based on data insights and feedback

**· Exposure to API integrations, credit bureaus (e.g., CIBIL), and payment gateways (Mandatory)**

**Interested applicants share your updated CV on hr@madhuvandealers.com.**

Pay: ₹750,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
title: Sr. Product Manager, Account Integrity
job_description:
**About Us**
------------

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

**Our People**
--------------

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

**Our Impact**
--------------

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact.  
We’re proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

  

**Role Overview**
-----------------

As the Senior Product Manager for Account Integrity, you will make sure every account on HighLevel is authentic and uses the platform as intended. You will own the strategy and roadmap for preventing fake account creation, bots and fake traffic, SMS abuse, email abuse, affiliate and benefits abuse, and the handling of third-party abuse complaints.

  

Abuse on HighLevel shows up on many surfaces at once: signup, public forms, messaging, affiliates, funnels and websites, domains, and AI agents. You will build the detection layer, a shared definition of an abusive account, and the graduated enforcement system that stops abuse early while keeping friction off legitimate businesses.

  

You will set requirements and shared standards for integrity across the platform, and partner with the engineering teams that own each surface to build on work they already have in flight. Success in this role depends on strong cross-team leadership, crisp prioritization, and the ability to make a data-backed case for integrity work across many roadmaps.

This role sits on the Trust & Safety product team and shares a common detection, trust-scoring, and enforcement platform with the Account Security and Payment Risk verticals.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Account Integrity across signup, forms, messaging, affiliates, hosting, domains, and AI features.
* Define a shared definition of an abusive or inauthentic account, and drive the Account Integrity North Star along with its input and counter metrics.
* Build signup and onboarding defenses: device, browser, and network fingerprinting, bot detection, velocity limits, and re-entry prevention for banned actors.
* Drive controls that prevent messaging abuse and toll fraud, such as volume and destination limits and spend ceilings, in partnership with the messaging and product teams.
* Define permission limits that unlock abusable capabilities, such as messaging at scale, payments, and payouts, as an account builds history and verifies who it is.
* Own graduated enforcement capabilities with clear appeal paths and audit trails.
* Build intake, routing, and SLAs for abuse and takedown reports.
* Partner with Affiliates, Finance, and Payments to detect affiliate and benefits abuse before commissions and credits are paid.
* Work with Support/CX on investigator tooling, playbooks, and the operational model for integrity reviews.
* Run a weekly review of abuse caught and missed, false positives and appeals, time to takedown, and the dollar and customer cost of each.

**Requirements**
----------------

* 6+ years of Product Management experience, including significant ownership of trust & safety, fraud, abuse prevention, integrity, or risk products.
* Experience building abuse detection, risk scoring, bot mitigation, or automated enforcement systems at scale.
* Strong understanding of platform abuse patterns: fake accounts, bots, SMS pumping and toll fraud, phishing and credential harvesting, promotion and affiliate abuse.
* Proven ability to lead through influence: driving priorities across engineering teams you do not manage.
* Strong analytical skills: comfortable writing SQL, defining labels and metrics, and reasoning about precision, recall, and false positive cost.
* Excellent written communication and stakeholder management across Engineering, Support, Legal, Finance, and senior leadership.

**Nice-to-Have**
----------------

* Experience with onboarding or growth products.
* Experience with abuse of generative AI products and agent safety controls.

**Core KPIs**
-------------

* Volume of accounts showing abusive behavior with financial impact.
* Reduction in fake signups and trials, SMS pumping volume and cost, and affiliate fraud losses.
* Median time to enforce.
* Share of abuse detected proactively rather than through customer, vendor, or third-party reports.
* False positive rate, appeal overturn rate, and support tickets driven by enforcement.
* Abuse report intake SLA and operational efficiency.

**Why Join HighLevel?**
-----------------------

At HighLevel, we foster an exciting and dynamic work environment driven by a passionate team. We believe in a collective responsibility where no task is considered someone else's job. Our unwavering focus is on providing value to our users, and we achieve this by delivering solutions swiftly through lean principles, allowing us to bring products to market in a matter of weeks rather than quarters.

Every good idea is put to the test, ensuring that we maintain a high standard of innovation. We prioritise the well-being of our team, recognizing that by taking care of them, they can better serve our users. We embrace the concept of continuous and iterative improvement, understanding that progress is an ongoing journey. We are also a well-funded and profitable company.

  

Join us at HighLevel, and you will have the opportunity to learn the intricacies of scaling a B2B SaaS startup and develop impactful products that cater to the needs of our customers.

**EEO Statement:**

The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. As an employer subject to affirmative action regulations, we invite you to voluntarily provide the following demographic information. This information is used solely for compliance with government recordkeeping, reporting, and other legal requirements. Providing this information is voluntary and refusal to do so will not affect your application status. This data will be kept separate from your application and will not be used in the hiring decision.  
  
We encourage you to review our Privacy Policy before submitting your application

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
