author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Staff Product Manager
job_description:
**Company Description**

Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.

There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.

At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And, over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.

Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.

 **Job Description**

As a Senior Staff Product Manager in the ITSM Product team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the next generation of enterprise service management. This is an opportunity to challenge conventional thinking, identify disruptive opportunities and redefine how enterprises manage IT services and operations.

You will operate at the intersection of ITSM, ITAM, ITOM and Artificial Intelligence, driving the evolution from traditional ticket-centric service management to intelligent, proactive and autonomous enterprise operations.

We are looking for a product leader who combines deep domain expertise with a strong innovation mindset, someone who can identify emerging customer problems, envision transformative solutions and translate them into differentiated products with significant business impact.

You will work closely with Engineering, AI, Design, GTM and Customer Success teams to take ideas from concept to market, influence strategic product investments and drive meaningful outcomes for customers and the business.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role that requires the ability to think strategically, operate independently and influence across organizational boundaries.

**Impact You Will Create**

**Reimagine the Future of ITSM**

Challenge traditional ITSM paradigms and define the next generation of enterprise service management experiences. Identify opportunities to move beyond reactive ticket management towards proactive, intelligent and autonomous IT operations.

**Drive Disruptive Product Innovation**

Identify whitespace opportunities, emerging customer problems and technology shifts to create differentiated product experiences. Lead 0-to-1 initiatives that have the potential to fundamentally change how enterprises operate.

**Shape AI-Native Product Experiences**

Leverage Generative AI, Agentic AI and intelligent automation to rethink existing workflows and create new ways of delivering enterprise services. Explore opportunities for autonomous resolution, contextual intelligence and intelligent orchestration.

**Influence Product Strategy & Business Outcomes**

Translate market opportunities and customer insights into compelling product strategies and roadmaps. Drive initiatives that strengthen competitive differentiation, accelerate adoption and create meaningful business impact.

**Champion Customer-Centric Innovation**

Engage deeply with enterprise customers to understand their operational challenges, validate new concepts and identify unmet needs. Connect customer problems with emerging technology capabilities to develop scalable solutions.

**Elevate Product Thinking**

Bring strong product judgment, strategic thinking and systems-level problem solving to complex product challenges. Influence and inspire cross-functional teams to raise the bar on product innovation and execution.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

**Product Vision & Strategy**

* Define and drive product vision and strategy for disruptive innovation across ITSM, ITAM and ITOM.
* Identify emerging market trends, technology shifts and evolving enterprise needs to uncover new product opportunities.
* Challenge existing assumptions and continuously explore ways to simplify and transform enterprise service management.
* Develop compelling product narratives and strategic investment proposals backed by customer insights and market opportunities.

**Innovation & Product Development**

* Lead 0-to-1 product initiatives, taking ideas from problem discovery and concept validation through product development, launch and adoption.
* Explore how AI, Agentic AI and intelligent automation can fundamentally transform traditional ITSM and IT operations workflows.
* Identify opportunities to create entirely new product experiences rather than simply incrementally improving existing capabilities.
* Drive rapid experimentation, prototyping and validation to establish product-market fit.

**Customer & Market Leadership**

* Develop a deep understanding of enterprise IT organizations, their operational models, challenges and evolving expectations.
* Engage with strategic customers, industry practitioners and market experts to identify unmet needs and validate product opportunities.
* Build a strong understanding of the competitive landscape, particularly emerging AI-native solutions and established enterprise platforms.
* Translate market and customer insights into differentiated product propositions.

**Cross-functional Leadership & Execution**

* Partner closely with Engineering, AI, Design, Architecture and GTM teams to translate product vision into execution.
* Influence cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders to drive alignment on strategic priorities and investment decisions.
* Navigate ambiguity, balance competing priorities and drive complex initiatives to successful outcomes.
* Ensure successful product launches by partnering with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success on positioning, readiness and adoption.

**Business & Product Impact**

* Own the success of strategic product initiatives, defining clear success metrics and driving measurable customer and business outcomes.
* Balance customer value, market opportunity, technical feasibility and commercial considerations in product decisions.
* Continuously assess product adoption, competitive differentiation and business impact to inform future investments.

 **Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

Skills

**Product Strategy & Innovation**

* Strong ability to envision and articulate transformative product strategies and identify opportunities beyond existing product paradigms.
* Demonstrated experience taking ambiguous problems and turning them into compelling product opportunities.
* Ability to think from first principles, challenge conventional approaches and drive 0-to-1 product innovation.
* Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS business models, product-led growth and commercial product strategy.

**Domain & Technology Expertise**

* Deep understanding of ITSM, ITAM, ITOM and enterprise service management ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of enterprise IT operations, service delivery models, workflows and operational challenges.
* Working knowledge of Generative AI, Agentic AI, intelligent automation and their potential to transform enterprise software.
* Ability to connect emerging technology capabilities with real-world customer problems and scalable product opportunities.

**Execution & Business Acumen**

* Proven ability to drive complex product initiatives from ideation through launch and market adoption.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven product decisions.
* Commercial acumen and the ability to connect product investments to customer value, revenue growth and competitive differentiation.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with execution excellence.

**Leadership & Communication**

* Exceptional ability to influence and align cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders without direct authority.
* Strong executive communication, storytelling and product narrative development skills.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and independently driving high-impact initiatives.
* Ability to inspire teams, challenge existing thinking and raise the bar on product craftsmanship.

**Qualifications**

* 15+ years of progressive Product Management experience, preferably in enterprise SaaS or enterprise software.
* Deep domain expertise in ITSM, ITAM, ITOM or adjacent enterprise technology domains is essential.
* Proven track record of driving strategic product initiatives and delivering differentiated products with measurable business impact.
* Demonstrated experience taking products or significant capabilities from concept to launch.
* Experience working on AI-driven products, intelligent automation or Agentic AI is a strong plus.
* Experience working with large enterprise customers and solving complex enterprise technology problems.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline; MBA is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy, influence senior stakeholders and drive outcomes across Product, Engineering and GTM organizations.

 **Additional Information**

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

**Company Description**

Organizations everywhere struggle under the crushing costs and complexities of “solutions” that promise to simplify their lives. To create a better experience for their customers and employees. To help them grow. Software is a choice that can make or break a business. Create better or worse experiences. Propel or throttle growth. Business software has become a blocker instead of ways to get work done.

There’s another option. Freshworks. With a fresh vision for how the world works.

At Freshworks, we build uncomplicated service software that delivers exceptional customer and employee experiences. Our enterprise-grade solutions are powerful, yet easy to use, and quick to deliver results. Our people-first approach to AI eliminates friction, making employees more effective and organizations more productive. Over 72,000 companies, including Bridgestone, New Balance, Nucor, S&P Global, and Sony Music, trust Freshworks’ customer experience (CX) and employee experience (EX) software to fuel customer loyalty and service efficiency. And, over 4,500 Freshworks employees make this possible, all around the world.

Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.

 **Job Description**

As a Senior Staff Product Manager in the ITSM Product team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the next generation of enterprise service management. This is an opportunity to challenge conventional thinking, identify disruptive opportunities and redefine how enterprises manage IT services and operations.

You will operate at the intersection of ITSM, ITAM, ITOM and Artificial Intelligence, driving the evolution from traditional ticket-centric service management to intelligent, proactive and autonomous enterprise operations.

We are looking for a product leader who combines deep domain expertise with a strong innovation mindset, someone who can identify emerging customer problems, envision transformative solutions and translate them into differentiated products with significant business impact.

You will work closely with Engineering, AI, Design, GTM and Customer Success teams to take ideas from concept to market, influence strategic product investments and drive meaningful outcomes for customers and the business.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role that requires the ability to think strategically, operate independently and influence across organizational boundaries.

**Impact You Will Create**

**Reimagine the Future of ITSM**

Challenge traditional ITSM paradigms and define the next generation of enterprise service management experiences. Identify opportunities to move beyond reactive ticket management towards proactive, intelligent and autonomous IT operations.

**Drive Disruptive Product Innovation**

Identify whitespace opportunities, emerging customer problems and technology shifts to create differentiated product experiences. Lead 0-to-1 initiatives that have the potential to fundamentally change how enterprises operate.

**Shape AI-Native Product Experiences**

Leverage Generative AI, Agentic AI and intelligent automation to rethink existing workflows and create new ways of delivering enterprise services. Explore opportunities for autonomous resolution, contextual intelligence and intelligent orchestration.

**Influence Product Strategy & Business Outcomes**

Translate market opportunities and customer insights into compelling product strategies and roadmaps. Drive initiatives that strengthen competitive differentiation, accelerate adoption and create meaningful business impact.

**Champion Customer-Centric Innovation**

Engage deeply with enterprise customers to understand their operational challenges, validate new concepts and identify unmet needs. Connect customer problems with emerging technology capabilities to develop scalable solutions.

**Elevate Product Thinking**

Bring strong product judgment, strategic thinking and systems-level problem solving to complex product challenges. Influence and inspire cross-functional teams to raise the bar on product innovation and execution.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

**Product Vision & Strategy**

* Define and drive product vision and strategy for disruptive innovation across ITSM, ITAM and ITOM.
* Identify emerging market trends, technology shifts and evolving enterprise needs to uncover new product opportunities.
* Challenge existing assumptions and continuously explore ways to simplify and transform enterprise service management.
* Develop compelling product narratives and strategic investment proposals backed by customer insights and market opportunities.

**Innovation & Product Development**

* Lead 0-to-1 product initiatives, taking ideas from problem discovery and concept validation through product development, launch and adoption.
* Explore how AI, Agentic AI and intelligent automation can fundamentally transform traditional ITSM and IT operations workflows.
* Identify opportunities to create entirely new product experiences rather than simply incrementally improving existing capabilities.
* Drive rapid experimentation, prototyping and validation to establish product-market fit.

**Customer & Market Leadership**

* Develop a deep understanding of enterprise IT organizations, their operational models, challenges and evolving expectations.
* Engage with strategic customers, industry practitioners and market experts to identify unmet needs and validate product opportunities.
* Build a strong understanding of the competitive landscape, particularly emerging AI-native solutions and established enterprise platforms.
* Translate market and customer insights into differentiated product propositions.

**Cross-functional Leadership & Execution**

* Partner closely with Engineering, AI, Design, Architecture and GTM teams to translate product vision into execution.
* Influence cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders to drive alignment on strategic priorities and investment decisions.
* Navigate ambiguity, balance competing priorities and drive complex initiatives to successful outcomes.
* Ensure successful product launches by partnering with Sales, Marketing and Customer Success on positioning, readiness and adoption.

**Business & Product Impact**

* Own the success of strategic product initiatives, defining clear success metrics and driving measurable customer and business outcomes.
* Balance customer value, market opportunity, technical feasibility and commercial considerations in product decisions.
* Continuously assess product adoption, competitive differentiation and business impact to inform future investments.

 **Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

Skills

**Product Strategy & Innovation**

* Strong ability to envision and articulate transformative product strategies and identify opportunities beyond existing product paradigms.
* Demonstrated experience taking ambiguous problems and turning them into compelling product opportunities.
* Ability to think from first principles, challenge conventional approaches and drive 0-to-1 product innovation.
* Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS business models, product-led growth and commercial product strategy.

**Domain & Technology Expertise**

* Deep understanding of ITSM, ITAM, ITOM and enterprise service management ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of enterprise IT operations, service delivery models, workflows and operational challenges.
* Working knowledge of Generative AI, Agentic AI, intelligent automation and their potential to transform enterprise software.
* Ability to connect emerging technology capabilities with real-world customer problems and scalable product opportunities.

**Execution & Business Acumen**

* Proven ability to drive complex product initiatives from ideation through launch and market adoption.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make data-driven product decisions.
* Commercial acumen and the ability to connect product investments to customer value, revenue growth and competitive differentiation.
* Ability to balance strategic thinking with execution excellence.

**Leadership & Communication**

* Exceptional ability to influence and align cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders without direct authority.
* Strong executive communication, storytelling and product narrative development skills.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguous environments and independently driving high-impact initiatives.
* Ability to inspire teams, challenge existing thinking and raise the bar on product craftsmanship.

**Qualifications**

* 15+ years of progressive Product Management experience, preferably in enterprise SaaS or enterprise software.
* Deep domain expertise in ITSM, ITAM, ITOM or adjacent enterprise technology domains is essential.
* Proven track record of driving strategic product initiatives and delivering differentiated products with measurable business impact.
* Demonstrated experience taking products or significant capabilities from concept to launch.
* Experience working on AI-driven products, intelligent automation or Agentic AI is a strong plus.
* Experience working with large enterprise customers and solving complex enterprise technology problems.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline; MBA is a plus.
* Demonstrated ability to operate with a high degree of autonomy, influence senior stakeholders and drive outcomes across Product, Engineering and GTM organizations.

 **Additional Information**

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. **Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.**

* Pune
* India
* Product Management - Finance/Supplier
* Mid Level
* Remote

  

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

**Why join Coupa?**

* **Pioneering Technology:** At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
* **Collaborative Culture:** We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
* **Global Impact:** Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.

Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

**The Impact of Sr Product Manager to Coupa**

Coupa Expenses is a modern expense management solution that helps companies simplify employee spend, from submitting and approving expenses to reimbursing employees and gaining real-time visibility into travel and expense (T&E) activity. By having a fully integrated Mobile and Card solutions, Coupa continually delivers customer value while meeting the evolving needs of our customers.

As the primary product manager on the Coupa Expenses team, you will drive product initiatives that deliver innovation, strengthen adoption, and unblock customers. This role calls for someone who thrives in ambiguity, builds trust across teams, and uses data to inform decisions. You bring a strong bias for action, deep curiosity about how our products work end-to-end, and a genuine desire to make both customers and colleagues successful.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Lead the Expenses teams product design and requirements across complex, cross-functional initiatives, partnering closely with Engineering, UX, Platform, and Success teams to align on scope, dependencies, and delivery approach.

* Build and maintain reporting and dashboards that give internal teams (Product, Growth, Leadership) clear visibility into product adoption, usage, and customer health.

* Act as a go-to subject matter expert for customer escalations, partnering with Support, Services, and Engineering to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.

* Translate customer feedback and usage data into clear product requirements and prioritization recommendations.

* Conduct competitive market analysis and continually assess the product's competitive position domestically and internationally.

* Support and help scale internal and external enablement (webinars, documentation, training) so Support, Services, and Customer Success teams can operate more self-sufficiently.

* Represent the product in customer-facing settings, including advisory boards, escalation calls, and adoption reviews.

### **What You Will Bring to Coupa**

* 7+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, fintech, or payments with a proven track record of **building buyer-facing products and consumer-grade UX**

* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives from ambiguous requirements through to delivery, coordinating effectively across Engineering, UX, and business stakeholders.

* Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience building or using dashboards/reporting tools (e.g., Metabase, Looker, Tableau) to drive product and business decisions.

* A track record of resolving complex customer issues and turning escalations into durable product or process improvements.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels.

* A collaborative, "roll up your sleeves" mindset paired with sound judgment on when to lead and when to support.

* Comfort operating with incomplete information and adapting quickly as priorities shift.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience in Expense Management, Corporate Cards, or related Finance/Procurement domains.

* Familiarity with SQL and comfort querying data directly to answer product questions.

* Experience working with or presenting to customer advisory boards or executive audiences.

* Knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or PeopleSoft.

* BA/BS technical degree preferred; MBA is a plus, or equivalent work experience.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

At Coupa, we are 100% committed to creating and nurturing an environment that supports your physical, mental, and community well-being. We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help you and your family thrive:

**Global Well-Being Perks (For All Employees Globally)**

* **Global Wellness Days:** Enjoy two designated, company-wide paid wellness days off each year (typically the first Friday in March and the last Friday in September) so the entire global team can unplug, step away, and recharge together .
* **Birthday Time-Off:** Celebrate your day! Coupa provides a paid day off on your birthday or another day of your choice within your birthday month .
* **Volunteer Time Off (VTO):** Giving back is in our DNA. We offer 40 hours of paid VTO annually to support the community initiatives and volunteer programs you are passionate about .
* **Employee Assistance Program (EAP):** Access free, confidential, 24/7/365 counseling and resources for emotional support, work-life solutions, financial advice, legal guidance, and support for new parents .
* **Business Travel Protection:** Travel with peace of mind. Zurich Travel Assist provides medical, safety, pre-trip planning, and emergency support during any business travel .
* **Referral Bonus Program:** Share the Coupa experience! Receive generous monetary referral bonuses when you successfully refer talented friends or acquaintances who are hired into open roles .

*Please note: In addition to these global well-being perks, Coupa offers highly competitive, location-specific benefits packages (which include comprehensive medical/dental insurance, retirement/pension plans, and life or accident protection) tailored to your primary work location. Your recruiter will walk you through the specific regional benefits package for this role during the interview process.*

Coupa complies with relevant laws and regulations regarding equal opportunity and offers a welcoming and inclusive work environment. Decisions related to hiring, compensation, training, or evaluating performance are made fairly, and we provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates and employees.

Please be advised that inquiries or resumes from recruiters will not be accepted.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read Coupa’s Privacy Policy and understand that Coupa receives/collects your application, including your personal data, for the purposes of managing Coupa's ongoing recruitment and placement activities, including for employment purposes in the event of a successful application and for notification of future job opportunities if you did not succeed the first time. You will find more details about how your application is processed, the purposes of processing, and how long we retain your application in our Privacy Policy.

  

**Benefits & Wellness**
-----------------------

### **Invested in you.**

We help families prepare for the changes in their lives. These benefits include preparing for the birth of a child, adoption, caring for elderly family members, transitioning back to work, and participation in Flexible Spending Accounts.

### **Invested in you.**

We help families prepare for the changes in their lives. These benefits include preparing for the birth of a child, adoption, caring for elderly family members, transitioning back to work, and participation in Flexible Spending Accounts.

### **Well-being head to toe.**

We provide Coupanians with comprehensive healthcare and mental wellness programs.

### **Time off to recharge.**

Generous paid time off including parental leave programs and volunteer time-off.

### **Celebrate your impact.**

We provide a generous 40 hours/year for volunteering and doubled matching contributions to $500 a year.

title: Senior Product Manager
job_description:
Who We Are

Bidgely (which means "electricity" in Hindi) is an AI-powered SaaS Company accelerating a clean energy future by enabling energy companies and consumers to make data-driven energy-related decisions.

Ranked #7 in Applied AI on Fast Company’s list of Most Innovative Companies in the World, Bidgely is putting customers at the center of the clean energy future

.

What We Do

Powered by our unique patented technology, Bidgely's UtilityAITM Platform transforms multiple dimensions of customer data - such as energy consumption, demographics, and interactions into deeply accurate and actionable consumer energy insights. We leverage these insights to empower each customer with personalized recommendations tailored to their individual personality and lifestyle, usage attributes, behavioral patterns, purchase propensity and beyond.

How We Do It

From a distributed energy resources (DER) and grid edge perspective, Bidgely is advancing smart meter innovation with data-driven solutions for solar PVs, electric vehicle (EV) detection, EV behavioral load shifting and managed charging, energy theft, short-term load forecasting, grid analytics and time of use (TOU) rate designs. Bidgely’s UtilityAITM energy analytics provides deep visibility into generation and consumption for better peak load shaping and grid planning and delivers targeted recommendations for new value-added products and services.

For more information, please visit-

Website: www.bidgely.com

Blog: bidgely.com/blog

How You Fit In

You will act as the GM of your problem space, balancing customer empathy, product excellence, and business impact. You are data-obsessed, have a bias-to-action, and fluent in transforming insights into scalable CX outcomes. Standout candidates will be AI-native—comfortable articulating an ML-powered alue proposition and using GenAI tools for speed and scale.

You will work cross-functionally across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, with responsibility for the end-to-end product lifecycle, from roadmap and design to launch and enablement.

What You’ll Do

* Own a customer problem area end‐to‐end: define the vision, strategy, metrics, and delivery to the market; shape a 6-12‐month roadmap.
* Discover & prioritize through market analysis, customer interviews, data mining, and experiment results.
* Write & drive clear PRDs/specs; partner with Design Team to deliver accessible, intuitive UX across channels.
* Collaborate with Engineering & Data Science to ship solutions incrementally, including data

integrations, data engines, multi-application channel UX

* Measure outcomes (adoption, CSAT/NPS, call deflection, savings, reliability SLOs); run A/B tests;
* Enable GTM with crisp positioning, packaging, and launch plans; support client success and pre‐sales narratives.
* Represent the product with utility clients, regulators, and internal execs; communicate trade‐offs & decisions in writing.

What Makes You Successful

* 4–7+ years in Product Management with SaaS + data/analytics; 2+ years owning a CX/engagement or data‐driven product.
* Strong technical fluency: read APIs, reason about data models, eventing, and privacy/consent implications. Comfort working with data scientists, engineers, and non-technical customers alike.
* Proven strategy execution muscle: experience in shipping multi‐quarter roadmaps, measurable outcomes, and scalable processes.
* Facility with experimentation and product analytics; comfort with funnels, cohorts, and AB testing.
* Excellent writing & stakeholder leadership; can align execs and clients around trade‐offs.
* Domain bonus: utilities/energy (DSM/DR, TOU rates, DER/EV/solar), CSR tooling, or regulated industries.

Nice to Have

* Experience with load disaggregation or energy analytics; GenAI applications in CX and internal tooling.
* Working with enterprise buyers, procurements, and security/compliance reviews.

Core Competencies

* Product Visionary – Connects customer needs, data insights, and business growth to a cohesive product direction.
* Bias for Action – Turns insights into results in days and weeks, not quarters.
* Data‐Driven Storyteller – Uses data and experimentation to inform judgment, trade‐offs, and

prioritization.

* Polished Communicator – Crafts clear narratives for executives, cross‐functional peers, and

customers.

* Hands‐On Technical Aptitude – Understands APIs, models, and AI tools; can prototype or debug to unblock progress.
* Customer‐Centric Leader – Demonstrates empathy for end users and utility partners alike.
* Team Leader – Builds collaboration, motivates cross‐functional teams, and raises the product bar.

Why Join Bidgely?

* Shape the future of clean energy. Your work will directly influence how millions of customers

experience, understand, and participate in the energy transition — from electrification and EVs to smarter home engagement.

* Build at scale, backed by real impact. Bidgely’s platform already analyzes billions of energy data points daily; you’ll lead initiatives that amplify that reach through data, AI, and design.
* Join a global, high-caliber team. Collaborate with passionate engineers, designers, data scientists, and utility innovators across Silicon Valley, India, and Europe — all driven by a shared mission to decarbonize intelligently.
* Thrive in a culture of ownership and innovation. Expect autonomy, transparency, and a bias for action — we value ideas over hierarchy and results over noise.
* Grow your craft and your career. With access to cutting-edge GenAI tools, continuous learning opportunities, and visible impact across markets, you’ll have the runway to evolve as a product leader and shape the next chapter of UtilityAITM.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Equal Opportunity

At Bidgely we’re on a mission to make a difference and build a workplace where every unique voice is heard and celebrated. Here, we believe that celebrating the unique backgrounds, perspectives and abilities of every employee makes an impact not only for our company internally but also for our clients, customers and community. We are an equal opportunity employer and believe that the inclusive atmosphere we build together will enable every person to grow, contribute and thrive. Our hiring decisions are based on your skills, talent, and passion – not on your background, gender, race, age, or the quirky way you dance at office parties.

* Write & drive clear PRDs/specs; partner with Design Team to deliver accessible, intuitive UX across channels.
* Collaborate with Engineering & Data Science to ship solutions incrementally, including data

integrations, data engines, multi-application channel UX

* Measure outcomes (adoption, CSAT/NPS, call deflection, savings, reliability SLOs); run A/B tests;
* Enable GTM with crisp positioning, packaging, and launch plans; support client success and pre‐sales narratives.
* Represent the product with utility clients, regulators, and internal execs; communicate trade‐offs & decisions in writing.

What Makes You Successful

* 4–7+ years in Product Management with SaaS + data/analytics; 2+ years owning a CX/engagement or data‐driven product.
* Strong technical fluency: read APIs, reason about data models, eventing, and privacy/consent implications. Comfort working with data scientists, engineers, and non-technical customers alike.
* Proven strategy execution muscle: experience in shipping multi‐quarter roadmaps, measurable outcomes, and scalable processes.
* Facility with experimentation and product analytics; comfort with funnels, cohorts, and AB testing.
* Excellent writing & stakeholder leadership; can align execs and clients around trade‐offs.
* Domain bonus: utilities/energy (DSM/DR, TOU rates, DER/EV/solar), CSR tooling, or regulated industries.

Nice to Have

* Experience with load disaggregation or energy analytics; GenAI applications in CX and internal tooling.
* Working with enterprise buyers, procurements, and security/compliance reviews.

Core Competencies

* Product Visionary – Connects customer needs, data insights, and business growth to a cohesive product direction.
* Bias for Action – Turns insights into results in days and weeks, not quarters.
* Data‐Driven Storyteller – Uses data and experimentation to inform judgment, trade‐offs, and

prioritization.

* Polished Communicator – Crafts clear narratives for executives, cross‐functional peers, and

customers.

* Hands‐On Technical Aptitude – Understands APIs, models, and AI tools; can prototype or debug to unblock progress.
* Customer‐Centric Leader – Demonstrates empathy for end users and utility partners alike.
* Team Leader – Builds collaboration, motivates cross‐functional teams, and raises the product bar.

Why Join Bidgely?

* Shape the future of clean energy. Your work will directly influence how millions of customers

experience, understand, and participate in the energy transition — from electrification and EVs to smarter home engagement.

* Build at scale, backed by real impact. Bidgely’s platform already analyzes billions of energy data points daily; you’ll lead initiatives that amplify that reach through data, AI, and design.
* Join a global, high-caliber team. Collaborate with passionate engineers, designers, data scientists, and utility innovators across Silicon Valley, India, and Europe — all driven by a shared mission to decarbonize intelligently.
* Thrive in a culture of ownership and innovation. Expect autonomy, transparency, and a bias for action — we value ideas over hierarchy and results over noise.
* Grow your craft and your career. With access to cutting-edge GenAI tools, continuous learning opportunities, and visible impact across markets, you’ll have the runway to evolve as a product leader and shape the next chapter of UtilityAITM.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Equal Opportunity

At Bidgely we’re on a mission to make a difference and build a workplace where every unique voice is heard and celebrated. Here, we believe that celebrating the unique backgrounds, perspectives and abilities of every employee makes an impact not only for our company internally but also for our clients, customers and community. We are an equal opportunity employer and believe that the inclusive atmosphere we build together will enable every person to grow, contribute and thrive. Our hiring decisions are based on your skills, talent, and passion – not on your background, gender, race, age, or the quirky way you dance at office parties.

How to Apply

The role

Own the path from market insight to product opportunity: find expensive customer problems on textile floors, prove customers will pay to solve them, work out with engineering what we can build, and turn it into a repeatable market.

What you will do

* Learn the textile value chain end to end — spinning, knitting, weaving, processing, finishing and material movement.
* Visit mills and run structured interviews with owners, plant heads, production, quality and maintenance teams.
* Quantify pain in rupees: waste, rework, downtime, labour, claims and throughput.
* Size markets bottom-up and map how customers solve the problem today.
* Validate willingness to pay through paid pilots, commitments and budget owners — not compliments.
* Assess technical feasibility with engineering and recommend go, test, pause or stop.
* Turn what works into positioning, ROI cases, sales tools and case studies.

Who we are looking for

* Evidence over confidence: you have found a real customer problem, verified it, sized it and tested whether customers would pay.
* Comfortable with numbers — unit economics, ROI and market sizing with transparent assumptions.
* Builds trust with industrial customers, and respectfully challenges assumptions, including the CEO's.
* Enough technical curiosity to work with engineers on feasibility.
* Typically 5–12 years in textile, product management, technical B2B marketing, consulting or market development.

Your first year

* A steady pipeline of well-evidenced product and market opportunities.
* A quantified view of the highest-value customer problems.
* Fewer engineering cycles spent on weakly validated ideas.
* More paid pilots, qualified pipeline and repeatable sales messaging.

Pay: From ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

author: Hiring Manager
title: Senior Product Manager I
job_description:
**Senior Product Manager - Search & Analytics Platform**

  

Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the data, query, and context foundations that help customers and AI agents understand and act on operational and security telemetry.

Effective investigation depends on finding the right data, querying it efficiently, and understanding how it relates to the customer's environment. As AI agents take on more analytical work, they need dependable access to telemetry and context: which service an entity belongs to, what it depends on, who owns it, and what changed. This role owns the shared platform capabilities that make that possible across observability, security, and platform optimization.

You will own established search and analytics capabilities while building toward federated analytics and a richer customer context foundation. This is a technically deep role requiring first-hand experience with data platforms, search, or analytics products, and the judgment to turn a broad platform vision into useful capabilities that teams can adopt.

**What You Will Own**

**The search and query platform.** Search and query capabilities, query language and analytical functions, partitions, views, and shared query services. You will own their roadmap, performance, reliability, and competitiveness, balancing analytical depth, ease of use, and cost for both human and agent workloads.

**Federated analytics.** Define how customers and agents query and correlate Sumo data with data in connected systems. Establish the use cases, supported analytical capabilities, and tradeoffs around data movement, freshness, performance, permissions, and cost, working closely with the teams responsible for integrations and access.

**Customer context and the knowledge graph.** Build the shared understanding of a customer's environment: entities, services, workloads, ownership, topology, and dependencies. Define how that context is assembled from telemetry, metadata, and connected systems, how relationships are maintained, and how the accumulated context improves investigation and analysis over time.

**Data discovery and shared context services.** Help people and agents discover available sources, schemas, fields, and relationships, and retrieve the data and context relevant to a task. Own the shared capabilities that make this information reusable across product experiences, with clear provenance, freshness, and permission boundaries.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* Set the multi-quarter vision and roadmap for the data and analytics platform, connecting current customer needs with the requirements of AI-assisted investigation.
* Own the health and evolution of shipping query capabilities, partitions, and views, using customer feedback and workload data to prioritize improvements.
* Work with engineering and architecture on query execution, distributed analytics, scalability, and cost at enterprise scale.
* Define and validate federated analytics use cases, and turn them into phased capabilities with clear behavior and limits.
* Develop the entity and context strategy, including how services and resources are identified consistently across data sources and related to one another.
* Partner with investigation, security, knowledge, and agent teams to turn their needs into shared platform capabilities and clear interfaces.
* Partner with the product and engineering teams responsible for platform governance to ensure query and context capabilities respect established access controls, audit requirements, and cost policies.
* Translate strategy into clear proposals, PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and rollout plans.
* Measure query success, latency, reliability, cost, context quality, and adoption, and show how platform improvements improve customer outcomes.

**What You Bring**

* 6+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of data platforms, search, query systems, or analytics products. Relevant platform experience is a hard requirement.
* Strong technical understanding of query processing, data organization, indexing, schemas, and distributed systems, with depth in one or more of these areas.
* Experience running a live product at scale, balancing customer commitments, performance, reliability, and cost while delivering a longer-term roadmap.
* Experience building shared platform capabilities, APIs, or services used by multiple product teams or external developers.
* The ability to reason about analytical correctness, incomplete data, data freshness, and the limits of what a system can reliably infer.
* Familiarity with federated analytics, metadata platforms, entity resolution, knowledge graphs, or retrieval systems. Experience in one or more of these areas is valuable.
* An understanding of how AI agents discover data, use tools, and retrieve context, or the ability to ramp quickly. Observability or security analytics experience is a plus.
* Strong analytical skills and comfort using SQL, dashboards, and usage data to understand customer behavior and evaluate tradeoffs.
* Clear communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write proposals that explain options, dependencies, and recommendations.

**Must Have Qualities**

* **Platform judgment.** Finds common needs across teams and turns them into capabilities others can depend on.
* **Customer grounding.** Connects technical investment to a concrete improvement in analysis, investigation, or cost.
* **Data correctness and trust.** Treats accuracy, consistency, provenance, and freshness as product requirements.
* **Runs today and builds tomorrow.** Keeps current capabilities healthy while delivering the next generation of the platform.
* **High ownership.** Resolves ambiguity, makes tradeoffs explicit, and drives work through delivery and adoption.

**About Us**
------------

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

Sumo Logic Privacy Policy. Employees will be responsible for complying with applicable federal privacy laws and regulations, as well as organizational policies related to data protection.

author: Hiring Manager
title: Sr Product Manager - Merchant
job_description:
**About the role and team**  
  
Product at Uber means making big decisions without perfect information—and owning the outcomes. As a Senior Product Manager (Tech), you will turn massive complexity into clarity at speed, navigating the "messy" reality of multi-sided marketplaces and high-stakes technical integrations. You will be at the heart of our most ambitious missions, architecting solutions that bridge the digital and physical worlds for millions of users globally.  
  
This is a high-visibility, high-impact role where you won’t just manage a roadmap; you will build 0-to-1 platforms that bridge the digital and physical worlds. You’ll need to lead through influence, not control, and stay resilient while balancing the needs of external partners, engineering teams, and global business units. If you are a curious, owner-minded product leader who is energized by challenge and motivated by real-world impact—this is where you’ll grow.  
  
**What you’ll do**  
  

* Build a bold product vision and strategy for your domain, identifying near and long-term initiatives that unlock the next wave of Uber’s global growth.
* Design and ship scalable technology solutions—including APIs, orchestration layers, and developer tools—to deeply interpret and respond to complex marketplace signals.
* Navigate and align cross-functional teams across Engineering, Data Science, Design, and Legal to drive cohesive product strategies despite competing priorities.
* Translate unstructured user pain points into clear product requirements by distilling complex problems, writing hypotheses, and defining measurable outcomes.
* Forge and manage strategic relationships with external partners, fintechs, or autonomous technology providers to scale deployments and optimize global operations.
Iterate relentlessly by distilling insights from performance dashboards, experimentation results, and user research to continuously raise the bar for quality and reliability.  

  
  
**Basic Qualifications**  
  

* 6 + years of experience as a Product Manager, with a proven track record of shipping large-scale projects each quarter that yield quantifiable impact.
* Proven ability to convert unstructured problems with significant ambiguity into clarifying, focused plans for multi-team projects.
* Strong technical depth: Able to coordinate large engineering efforts, identify potential technical risks, and act as an effective partner for engineering managers across teams.
* Experience defining OKRs and roadmaps for complex programs/platforms, ensuring teams operate with minimal noise and a rapid clip of high-quality delivery.
* Demonstrated leadership in overseeing deeply experimental teams, partnering with data science managers to drive strong experimentation and data-driven prioritization.
* Proficient in UX/UI paradigms: Ability to own the design process for complex products, providing deep context to designers while driving fast iteration cycles for new concepts.
* Experience representing significant areas of work to executives to gather feedback, generate alignment, and garner support.
Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related technical/quantitative field.  

  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  

* Domain expertise in Financial Services, Autonomous Vehicles, or high-scale Marketplace mechanics.
* Passionate about shipping "magical," defect-free products, overseeing quality monitoring, alerting, and retrospective processes.
* Proven recruiter and mentor: Ability to successfully hire for the team and serve as a coveted member of all product interview loops.
* Strategic 0-to-1 experience: Generating innovative ideas for new product areas and incorporating customer feedback into long-term visions.
Global experience: Building and launching products that bridge digital and physical worlds across diverse regional contexts.  

  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

**What you’ll do**  
  

* Build a bold product vision and strategy for your domain, identifying near and long-term initiatives that unlock the next wave of Uber’s global growth.
* Design and ship scalable technology solutions—including APIs, orchestration layers, and developer tools—to deeply interpret and respond to complex marketplace signals.
* Navigate and align cross-functional teams across Engineering, Data Science, Design, and Legal to drive cohesive product strategies despite competing priorities.
* Translate unstructured user pain points into clear product requirements by distilling complex problems, writing hypotheses, and defining measurable outcomes.
* Forge and manage strategic relationships with external partners, fintechs, or autonomous technology providers to scale deployments and optimize global operations.
Iterate relentlessly by distilling insights from performance dashboards, experimentation results, and user research to continuously raise the bar for quality and reliability.  

  
  
**Basic Qualifications**  
  

* 6 + years of experience as a Product Manager, with a proven track record of shipping large-scale projects each quarter that yield quantifiable impact.
* Proven ability to convert unstructured problems with significant ambiguity into clarifying, focused plans for multi-team projects.
* Strong technical depth: Able to coordinate large engineering efforts, identify potential technical risks, and act as an effective partner for engineering managers across teams.
* Experience defining OKRs and roadmaps for complex programs/platforms, ensuring teams operate with minimal noise and a rapid clip of high-quality delivery.
* Demonstrated leadership in overseeing deeply experimental teams, partnering with data science managers to drive strong experimentation and data-driven prioritization.
* Proficient in UX/UI paradigms: Ability to own the design process for complex products, providing deep context to designers while driving fast iteration cycles for new concepts.
* Experience representing significant areas of work to executives to gather feedback, generate alignment, and garner support.
Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related technical/quantitative field.  

  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  

* Domain expertise in Financial Services, Autonomous Vehicles, or high-scale Marketplace mechanics.
* Passionate about shipping "magical," defect-free products, overseeing quality monitoring, alerting, and retrospective processes.
* Proven recruiter and mentor: Ability to successfully hire for the team and serve as a coveted member of all product interview loops.
* Strategic 0-to-1 experience: Generating innovative ideas for new product areas and incorporating customer feedback into long-term visions.
Global experience: Building and launching products that bridge digital and physical worlds across diverse regional contexts.  

  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. title: Sr Product Manager - Payments Platform
job_description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.

Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.

It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.

Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.

In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.

**About the role**

When a contractor in Brazil gets paid on time, a business in Singapore settles in the right currency, or a payroll platform moves money to 40 countries without a single failure: that's what a good payments platform looks like from the outside. From the inside, it's hard decisions about which rails to build on, what reliability means at scale, and how to make a platform handling billions a month behave consistently across markets with completely different rules.

Nium processes cross-border payments for banks, fintechs, and enterprise platforms across 100+ countries. The Senior PM - Payments Platform owns the rails those payments run on.

### **Responsibilities**

* **Reliability.** Define what "good" looks like for corridor performance, settlement success, and straight-through processing. Set the targets, own them, move them.

* **Corridor and market design**. Each market has its own mechanics and failure modes. You translate that into requirements: what the corridor supports, how failure is handled, what go-live looks like, so the products built on top can make promises to customers and keep them.

* **Integration standards.**You set the bar for what gets built with correspondent banks, local networks, and processors globally. You decide which integrations are worth doing, weighing partner economics and business impact against build and maintenance cost, and you push the ones that matter through to delivery.

* **Resilience.** Design for failure: redundancy, failover, degraded modes. The goal is a platform where a single rail going down doesn't mean customers feel it.

* **AI and agentic payment flows**. This is the frontier. Payments infrastructure today is reactive: something breaks, someone fixes it. We want infrastructure that thinks: routes intelligently, detects degradation before customers feel it, reconciles autonomously, resolves failures without human escalation. Nium wants to be the first payments infrastructure company to make agentic flows core to how money moves. You define what that looks like and build it.

### **Requirements**

* Payments experience at real scale: high volume, multi-market, genuine accountability when things break. You understand the mechanics (settlement windows, return codes, reconciliation, failure handling) well enough to bring unambiguous requirements.

* Curious about how payments work across markets. AI-native in how you work. Rigorous about prioritization. Opinionated, not passive: you form a point of view on how a corridor or integration should work, and you push it forward rather than waiting to be told what to build.

* You push Engineering on trade-offs and bring them along with you, holding ground on what's right for the corridor and the business without needing positional authority to do it. And above all, you are passionate about the customer outcome at the end of the transaction, not the platform for its own sake.

* 3-5 years in product management. Payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure is a requirement. Experience with real-time rails (UPI, SEPA, RTP, Pix, or equivalents) is a strong plus.

**The Opportunity**

Most payments PMs work on one market, one rail, one product type. Here you work on all of them simultaneously: Asia-Pacific, Americas, Europe, MENA, all with different mechanics and failure modes. The exposure you get in two years compresses what usually takes a decade.

The team is small, senior, and ambitious. The infrastructure you build will process tens of billions of dollars a month and affect the finances of real people and businesses, including the first generation of payments that run through AI agents rather than human-initiated flows.

**How We’ll Measure You**

* Corridor success rate and STP rate, moved quarter over quarter.

* Settlement failure rate and time-to-resolution.

* Integration delivery against committed dates.

* Reduction in payment failures from platform-layer decisions.

**What we offer at Nium**

**We Value Performance:** Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work.

**We Care for Our Employees:** The wellness of Nium’ers is our #1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24/7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our discretionary year-end shut down (dependant on company OKRs). We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office).

**We Upskill Ourselves:** We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend.

**We Celebrate Together:** We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more!

**We Thrive with Diversity:** Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.

  

**Beware of recruitment scams:** Be cautious of individuals impersonating Nium via WhatsApp, social media, email or unofficial websites. **Do not respond, share personal or financial information, or make any payments**. Nium will never ask candidates to transfer money or cryptocurrency as part of our recruitment process.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Principal Product Manager
job_description:
**Principal Product Manager – Post Purchase & Returns**

**About us:**

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America’s leading retailers.

Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.

Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Guest Experience organization. Target is well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target. We study our guests to discover new needs and insights and then craft every interaction to build brand love. We are market experts who insist on a clear and cohesive understanding of our business objectives, guest segments and behaviors, strategies and tactics, overcoming obstacles and measuring success. Leveraging our collective assets and fostering a healthy, supportive and open team culture, we deliver a holistically gratifying experience that guests can only get at Target.

The **Post Purchase & Returns Product team** is responsible for creating seamless, reliable, and differentiated guest experiences after an order is placed. The team builds capabilities across order tracking, fulfillment, order modifications, payments, returns, and refunds, enabling greater transparency, convenience, and control for guests. Through platform modernization, intelligent automation, and innovative digital experiences, we strive to simplify complex post-purchase journeys, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen guest trust and loyalty.

**About the role:**

This **Principal Product Manager – Post Purchase & Returns** role will be based in Target in India (TII) and will serve as a senior individual contributor, driving product strategy and execution for critical capabilities within Target's post-purchase ecosystem in close partnership with leaders and teams across Target.

As Principal Product Manager, you will define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for complex post-purchase capabilities, translating guest needs, business priorities, and technology opportunities into scalable solutions. You will drive meaningful improvements in guest experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes while ensuring products meet enterprise standards for reliability, usability, and scalability.

You will lead highly complex initiatives spanning multiple business and technology teams, partnering with senior leaders across Digital, Stores, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, and Guest Services to align priorities, navigate trade-offs, and remove execution barriers. You will influence decisions across interconnected products and platforms, balancing long-term strategic investments with near-term business needs.

You will lead product discovery with key stakeholders, leveraging guest insights, analytics, experimentation, and competitive intelligence to validate opportunities and inform product decisions. You will establish clear goals and OKRs, assess product health and financial impact, and use data-driven insights to prioritize investments and deliver measurable outcomes.

You will partner closely with engineering and architecture teams to modernize foundational platforms, improve system reliability, and identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to simplify post-purchase experiences and operations.

As a senior individual contributor, you will serve as a product thought leader, influencing product direction across teams, mentoring product managers, and elevating product management practices through expertise, collaboration, and strategic influence rather than direct people management.

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

**About you:**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience.
* 7+ years of product management experience, including experience leading complex, enterprise-scale digital products.
* Proven experience defining product strategy and roadmaps and driving measurable business outcomes across complex product ecosystems.
* Strong understanding of e-commerce, retail, order management, fulfillment, or post-purchase experiences, including order tracking, modifications, cancellations, returns, and refunds.
* Demonstrated ability to lead highly complex, cross-functional initiatives across multiple business and technology teams, navigating ambiguity and competing priorities.
* Experience partnering with engineering and architecture teams to build scalable, reliable platforms and modernize legacy technology ecosystems.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to evaluate guest experience, operational efficiency, financial impact, and return on investment to inform product decisions.
* Expertise in product discovery, experimentation, analytics, and data-driven decision-making, with a strong ability to define OKRs and measure product success.
* Strong communication and executive presence, with a proven track record of influencing senior leaders and driving alignment across large enterprise organizations.
* Expertise in agile product development, including iterative delivery, prioritization, user stories, and working with cross-functional scrum teams.
* Strategic mindset and bias for action, with the ability to balance long-term product vision with near-term execution and business priorities.
* Ability to identify opportunities to leverage emerging technologies, including AI and automation, to improve guest experiences and operational efficiency.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor product managers, elevate product thinking, and drive strategic influence without formal people management authority.
* Strong ability to build relationships and collaborate across Digital, Stores, Supply Chain, Engineering, Finance, Guest Services, and Target in India.

**Know More About Us here:**

* **Life at Target**: https://india.target.com/
* **Benefits**: https://india.target.com/life-at-target/workplace/benefits
* **Culture**: https://india.target.com/life-at-target/belonging
* **Target** **Tech**: https://tech.target.com/

title: Product Manager, Toll.OS (Tolling, ITMS and ATMS)_MPIN
job_description:
**Company Description**

**Purpose of the role**

Bosch Mobility Platform and Solutions (MPS) builds software platforms and digital services for the mobility ecosystem: tolling and traffic, logistics and fleets, commerce and marketplaces, financial services, and the cloud and data platform that runs underneath them. MPS works with partners and customers across India, Europe and North America, and operates like a digital-native business inside Bosch.

Toll.OS is the open-road tolling and traffic platform of Bosch MPS for Indian highways. It combines RFID and FASTag reads, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and sensors into one verified transaction, and it runs on a layered architecture from the roadside edge to back-office reconciliation. It is live on a national highway today and is designed to scale from one gantry to many corridors.

The Toll.OS play also covers intelligent traffic management and enforcement at junctions and corridors, and the integration of tolling with highway Advanced Traffic Management Systems (ATMS) as national highway authorities specify in their tenders. The Product Manager owns this play as a product: what is built, how it performs in the field, what it costs to run, and what it needs to win the next deployment.

 **Job Description**

**What the role owns**

**Product strategy and roadmap** - Own and evolve the roadmap across tolling (multi-lane free flow and plaza software), intelligent traffic management and enforcement, and integration with highway ATMS. Sequence work by customer need, economics, certification effort and regulatory readiness.

**Field learning into requirements** - Work from live deployments: recognition accuracy, manual validation rate, reconciliation gaps, notice and dispute failures, incident root causes. Turn each pattern into a prioritised backlog item with an owner.

**Recognition and sensor-fusion quality** - Define accuracy and confidence targets across RFID, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and other sensors. Work with engineering and AI teams on model, camera and edge decisions, and lead make-or-buy choices on components.

**Interoperability, compliance and security** - Ensure the product meets national interoperability specifications for electronic toll collection, RFID and equipment standards, certification requirements, data protection, audit logging and retention. Work with Legal and Compliance on regulatory change.

**Tender and bid support** - Own the technical content of responses to highway authority and concessionaire tenders: compliance matrices, equivalence of components, architecture and service-level proposals. Work with Finance on bid-versus-investment discipline.

**Deployment and operations readiness** - Define site readiness, integration with acquirer banks and payment networks, settlement and reconciliation, service-level design and acceptance criteria. Hand over cleanly to operations and keep the live KPIs visible.

**Unit economics** - Own cost per passage and cost per plaza, and shape transaction-fee and service models with Finance, so the product stays competitive in price-led tenders.

**Ecosystem and partners** - Work with highway authorities, concessionaires, acquirer banks, system integrators and hardware vendors. Work with the Global Partner Manager on technology and supplier partnerships.

**Platform and data integration** - Publish passage and vehicle events into the Mobility Prism platform so the same vehicle can be understood across tolling, traffic and other services, within consent and data protection rules.

**Team and ways of working** - Guide the product owners and engineering squads working on Toll.OS using agile (SAFe) practices, and build the product-management discipline of the team through coaching and clear decision records

**How the role is measured**

The role is accountable for business outcomes, not only for product documentation. Effectiveness is assessed on:

* Recognition accuracy and share of passages verified without manual review
* Time from field issue to product fix
* Cost per passage and cost per plaza trend
* Technical compliance rate and win rate on tenders the role supported
* Deployment lead time from contract to go-live
* Reconciliation and settlement accuracy with acquirer banks
* Number of corridors and plazas running on the standard product
* Quality of field feedback captured into the roadmap

 **Qualifications**

**Who we are looking for**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (electronics, electrical, computer science, civil or transportation); a master's degree or MBA is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 8 to 12+ years in product management, systems engineering or programme leadership in intelligent transport systems, electronic toll collection, smart-city or transport technology, payments infrastructure or computer-vision based systems.
* Has owned a product or system through design, certification, field deployment and operation, and has seen how it behaves when real traffic arrives.
* Experience in public-sector or regulated procurement (tenders, compliance matrices, service-level and performance guarantees) is strongly preferred.

**Domain and technical knowledge**

* Electronic toll collection: FASTag and national electronic toll collection specifications, RFID standards, acquirer and issuer roles, settlement and reconciliation.
