text:
**Company Description**

**Purpose of the role**

Bosch Mobility Platform and Solutions (MPS) builds software platforms and digital services for the mobility ecosystem: tolling and traffic, logistics and fleets, commerce and marketplaces, financial services, and the cloud and data platform that runs underneath them. MPS works with partners and customers across India, Europe and North America, and operates like a digital-native business inside Bosch.

Toll.OS is the open-road tolling and traffic platform of Bosch MPS for Indian highways. It combines RFID and FASTag reads, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and sensors into one verified transaction, and it runs on a layered architecture from the roadside edge to back-office reconciliation. It is live on a national highway today and is designed to scale from one gantry to many corridors.

The Toll.OS play also covers intelligent traffic management and enforcement at junctions and corridors, and the integration of tolling with highway Advanced Traffic Management Systems (ATMS) as national highway authorities specify in their tenders. The Product Manager owns this play as a product: what is built, how it performs in the field, what it costs to run, and what it needs to win the next deployment.

 **Job Description**

**What the role owns**

**Product strategy and roadmap** - Own and evolve the roadmap across tolling (multi-lane free flow and plaza software), intelligent traffic management and enforcement, and integration with highway ATMS. Sequence work by customer need, economics, certification effort and regulatory readiness.

**Field learning into requirements** - Work from live deployments: recognition accuracy, manual validation rate, reconciliation gaps, notice and dispute failures, incident root causes. Turn each pattern into a prioritised backlog item with an owner.

**Recognition and sensor-fusion quality** - Define accuracy and confidence targets across RFID, number-plate recognition, vehicle classification and other sensors. Work with engineering and AI teams on model, camera and edge decisions, and lead make-or-buy choices on components.

**Interoperability, compliance and security** - Ensure the product meets national interoperability specifications for electronic toll collection, RFID and equipment standards, certification requirements, data protection, audit logging and retention. Work with Legal and Compliance on regulatory change.

**Tender and bid support** - Own the technical content of responses to highway authority and concessionaire tenders: compliance matrices, equivalence of components, architecture and service-level proposals. Work with Finance on bid-versus-investment discipline.

**Deployment and operations readiness** - Define site readiness, integration with acquirer banks and payment networks, settlement and reconciliation, service-level design and acceptance criteria. Hand over cleanly to operations and keep the live KPIs visible.

**Unit economics** - Own cost per passage and cost per plaza, and shape transaction-fee and service models with Finance, so the product stays competitive in price-led tenders.

**Ecosystem and partners** - Work with highway authorities, concessionaires, acquirer banks, system integrators and hardware vendors. Work with the Global Partner Manager on technology and supplier partnerships.

**Platform and data integration** - Publish passage and vehicle events into the Mobility Prism platform so the same vehicle can be understood across tolling, traffic and other services, within consent and data protection rules.

**Team and ways of working** - Guide the product owners and engineering squads working on Toll.OS using agile (SAFe) practices, and build the product-management discipline of the team through coaching and clear decision records

The role is accountable for business outcomes, not only for product documentation. Effectiveness is assessed on:

* Recognition accuracy and share of passages verified without manual review
* Time from field issue to product fix
* Cost per passage and cost per plaza trend
* Technical compliance rate and win rate on tenders the role supported
* Deployment lead time from contract to go-live
* Reconciliation and settlement accuracy with acquirer banks
* Number of corridors and plazas running on the standard product
* Quality of field feedback captured into the roadmap

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering (electronics, electrical, computer science, civil or transportation); a master's degree or MBA is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 8 to 12+ years in product management, systems engineering or programme leadership in intelligent transport systems, electronic toll collection, smart-city or transport technology, payments infrastructure or computer-vision based systems.
* Has owned a product or system through design, certification, field deployment and operation, and has seen how it behaves when real traffic arrives.

title: Sr. Product Manager (ITSM)
job_description:
Are you driven to shape innovative AI-powered product experiences, and looking to join a team where open collaboration, customer focus, and a commitment to excellence are core values? At Ivanti, we work passionately and authentically, striving to win together and make a real impact for our customers and each other. Join us to elevate your career and help shape the future of Enterprise Service Management through innovative conversational and collaboration experiences.

**Why We Need You?**

The Senior Product Manager role combines customer engagement, product strategy, innovation, and close partnership with design and engineering. The ideal candidate has strong product management experience, particularly within AI, chatbots, conversational interfaces, or Enterprise Service Management. You will work regularly with customers to understand how they operate, identify the problems and jobs to be done, and act as the voice of the customer throughout the design and development process.

You will also support the ideation, design, technical development, and launch of innovative products and capabilities, helping drive the continued evolution of Ivanti's Enterprise Service Management portfolio.

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Product Manager to lead the development and enhancement of our virtual assistant, chatbot, and chat, as well as other collaboration capabilities for Ivanti's Service and Asset Management suite. This role is crucial in shaping the future of our AI-driven conversational interfaces, ensuring they meet the needs of our customers and deliver exceptional user experiences. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in product management, with emphasis in the AI and chatbot space, and will be adept at navigating the complexities of developing innovative solutions.

**Why We Need you!**

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Product Manager to lead the development and enhancement of our virtual assistant, chatbot, and chat, as well as other collaboration capabilities for Ivanti's Service and Asset Management suite. This role is crucial in shaping the future of our AI-driven conversational interfaces, ensuring they meet the needs of our customers and deliver exceptional user experiences. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in product management, with emphasis in the AI and chatbot space, and will be adept at navigating the complexities of developing innovative solutions.

**Who You Are!**

Interacting on a regular basis with customers, you are someone understands how customers work in the area of Enterprise Service Management. You enjoy partnering with customers to define the problems to be solved and jobs be done, and you act as the voice of the customer during the design and development process. In all you build, you work to ensure that new product capabilities solve meaningful customer problems. You also support the ideation, design, technical development, and launch of innovative new products and modules in support of the continued evolution of the Ivanti's Enterprise Service Management portfolio.

**What You Will Be Doing:**

As part of the role, the ideal candidate understands the mechanics of the enterprise software market, understand requirements to deliver successful SaaS products and services, and needs to have business acumen to make smart decisions to optimize return on investment for the Ivanti ESM product line. Key to the success of the position is to be able to develop and maintain good business relationships with cross-functional teams, which are essential to the successful adoption of new capabilities.

If you are looking for an opportunity to deliver meaningful innovations to enable our target customers to manage their IT or non-IT services better and thus improve their business success and work experience, and if you are looking for an opportunity to help lead Ivanti's ESM business to financial success and to participate in it, then join our team!

**Key Responsibilities**

Product Strategy and Roadmap:

* Develop and execute the product vision and strategy for virtual assistants, chatbots, and other collaborative capabilities.
* Create and manage a product roadmap, aligning with business objectives and market demands.
* Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities and inform product decisions.

Product Development:

* Lead cross-functional teams, including engineering, UX, and data science, to deliver high-quality products.
* Define detailed product requirements and specifications, ensuring clarity and alignment with business goals.
* Prioritize features and enhancements based on customer feedback, market trends, and business impact.

Customer Focus:

* Engage with customers and stakeholders to gather insights, understand their needs, and validate product concepts.
* Advocate for the customer by ensuring their needs are at the forefront of product development efforts.
* Develop user personas and journey maps to guide the design and development process.

Performance and Metrics:

* Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and success metrics to measure adoption and performance.
* Analyze data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
* Report on progress to senior leadership and stakeholders.

Collaboration and Communication:

* Collaborate with marketing, sales, services, and customer support teams to ensure successful product launches and customer adoption.
* Communicate product vision, strategy, and updates effectively to internal and external stakeholders.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement within the product team.

Innovation and Trends:

* Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and advancements in AI, chatbots, and collaboration.
* Identify and evaluate new technologies and solutions to enhance product offerings.
* Drive innovation by exploring new use cases and applications for virtual assistants and chatbots.

**What Will You Bring?**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. MBA or advanced degree is a plus.
* Experience: Minimum of 5 years of product management experience, with at least 3 years focused on AI, virtual assistants, or chatbots.
* Skills: Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to lead and inspire cross-functional teams.
* Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with AI technologies, natural language processing (NLP), machine learning, and chatbot frameworks.
* Customer Orientation: Deep understanding of customer needs and a passion for creating user-centric products.
* Project Management: Proven track record of managing complex projects and delivering products on time and within budget.

  

**Why Ivanti?**

* **Friendly flexible working model:** Empower excellence whether you're at home or in the office and support work-life balance**.**
* **Competitive compensation & total rewards**: Including health, wellness, and financial plans tailored for you and your family.
* **Global, diverse teams:** Collaborate with talented people from 23+ countries.
* **Learning & development:** Grow your skills with access to best-in-class learning tools and programs.
* **Equity & belonging:** We value every voice. Your story helps inform our solutions for a changing world.

**What drives us:**

Ivanti's mission is to elevate human potential within organizations by managing, protecting and automating technology for continuous innovation. It is through diverse and inclusive hiring, decision-making, and commitment to our employees and partners that we will continue to build and deliver world-class solutions for our customers.

*To learn more about Ivanti's* *Mission and Core Values.*

**Inclusion at Ivanti:**

Ivanti is proud to be an **Equal Opportunity Employer**. We're committed to building a diverse team and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone belongs. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and walks of life.

Need adjustments during the process? Reach out to talent@ivanti.com we're happy to help.

The role is responsible for product and solutions planning and execution across India, including assessing customer needs, analyzing market trends, and prioritizing product requirements. Responsibilities

job_description:
Role: **Associate Technical Product ManagerRole Definitions**Role type: Full-time / PermanentDepartment: Technical Product Management / R&D EngineeringExperience: 2 years in Engineering, Fresher in ManagementJob Location: Kochi, Infopark (On-site)Industry: Telecom/IoT/Electronics/Semiconductor**Role Summary:**As an Associate Technical Product Manager, you will act as the crucial anchor connecting product strategy, engineering delivery, and customer enablement. You will collaborate closely with embedded hardware and firmware engineers, cellular modem specialists, field application engineers, and quality assurance teams.You will own the day-to-day execution of the product backlog for cellular module software/hardware features and platform capabilities. Your primary mission is to translate complex business and technical requirements into well-defined user stories, prioritize deliverables to maximize sprint velocity and quality, and ensure seamless delivery of carrier-grade IoT hardware and software solutions.**Key Responsibilities:**

* Product Backlog & Agile/Scrum Ownership.
* *Serve as the dedicated Product Owner for cross-functional Agile engineering teams (Embedded Firmware, Hardware, and Modem Protocol Stacks).*
* *Own, groom, and maintain a high-quality product backlog; author detailed, unambiguous user stories, technical specifications, and clear acceptance criteria.*
* *Actively lead core Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily standups, backlog grooming/refinement, sprint reviews/demos, and retrospectives.*
* *Collaborate with Engineering Leads to define sprint goals, track team velocity, remove technical impediments, and ensure on-time delivery.*
* Technical Requirements Definition & Lifecycle Management
* *Translate customer needs, market insights, and architectural roadmaps into clear Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), feature specification sheets, and interface requirements.*
* *Define feature sets and technical requirements for cellular module firmware, AT command sets, SDKs, power management profiles, and protocol stacks .*
* *Work with the engineering team to define seamless cloud-device integration requirements, including eSIM profile switching, remote device telemetry, FOTA (Firmware Over-The-Air) update workflows, and security protocols.*
* *Track product delivery through all developmental phases: Concept, Engineering Validation Test (EVT), Design Validation Test (DVT), Production Validation Test (PVT), and Mass Production (MP).*
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment
* *Interface continuously between R&D (Hardware, Firmware, RF), Testing & QA,*
* *Align feature scope and timelines with global sales, customer support, and product marketing teams.*
* *Support regulatory and carrier certification processes (CE, FCC, PTCRB, GCF, and telecom network operator approvals) by coordinating technical test requirements and compliance deliverables.*
* Quality Assurance, Validation & Continuous Improvement
* *Participate in feature sign-offs, sprint validation, and user acceptance testing (UAT) before production releases.*
* *Monitor bug triage, analyse defect reports, and prioritize critical fixes in upcoming sprints.*
* *Solicit direct feedback from customer deployments, pilot runs, and field telemetry to uncover product enhancements and drive continuous product iteration.*
* Knowledge Transfer & Team Enablement
* *Responsible for technical knowledge transfer (KT), product training, and enablement for customer-interfacing teams, including Sales, Customer Support, and Field Application Engineers (FAE).*
* *Provide documentation, technical guidance, and feature walkthroughs to ensure customer-facing teams effectively support and troubleshoot customer deployments.*

**Required Skills:**

* Technical Knowledge / Skills
* *Solid foundational understanding of cellular IoT and wireless telecommunication standards (5G, 4G LTE, Wi-Fi, BT, NB-IoT, GNSS).*
* *Familiarity with embedded system architectures, microcontroller platforms, and serial communication protocols (UART, USB, SPI, I2C, PCIe, LPDDR, MIPI-DSI, MIPI-CSI).*
* *Understanding of IoT networking protocols (MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, CoAP, TCP/UDP) and AT command interfaces.*
* *Familiarity with eSIM / eUICC technology, FOTA update mechanisms, and cloud-based IoT device management platforms.*
* *Working knowledge of hardware/software release processes, version control, and bug tracking systems.*
* *Demonstrated experience operating in Agile/Scrum frameworks, managing product backlogs, and leading sprint workflows.*
* *Proven track record of translating complex technical concepts into well-structured user stories and product specifications.*
* Core Competencies & Soft Skills
* *Exceptional written and verbal technical communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical architectures clearly to engineering teams and business stakeholders.*
* *Strong analytical mindset with rigorous problem-solving abilities and obsessive attention to detail.*
* *High degree of ownership, self-motivation, and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth hardware-software product environment.*
* *Ability to balance technical trade-offs against business value and project delivery schedules.*

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* MBA graduates with a foundational degree in Engineering
* ***Bachelor’s/Master’s degree*** *in Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE), Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline.*
* *Complemented by* ***Master of Business Administration (MBA)*** *in Technology Management / Information Management, Strategy / Strategic Management, Entrepreneurship and Innovation or a related discipline.*

**Professional Experience:**2+ years of hands-on experience as an Engineer (Systems/Embedded, Hardware, RF, etc.) prior to earning an MBA. Fresh MBA graduates with this requisite engineering background

Interested candidates please share your resumes to aswathy.r@cavliwireless.com

Pay: ₹385,000.00 - ₹660,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

title: AI Product Manager
job_description:
**Who We Are?**

Cleantech Industry Resources accelerates solar, wind, green hydrogen, battery storage, and EV infrastructure projects across the United States, India, and EMEA markets. The company provides turnkey "Development as a Service," powered by 100% internal systems engineering and a world-class team that comes out of some of the most reputed organizations in the renewables industry. This team operates within a sophisticated software and AI environment to support projects from land origination, through to commercial operation.

**Location of Position:**

* Chennai

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to join a top-notch, collaborative team of professionals
* Fantastic team environment and collaborative culture
* Professional development opportunities to grow into an industry leader
* Medical Insurance for the employee and family
* Spot Recognition bonus for exceptional performance
* Long Term Incentive policy
* Regular team outings, events, and activities to foster a positive work environment

**Our Commitment to Diversity**

At CIR, we are dedicated to nurturing a diverse and equitable workforce that truly reflects our community. We deeply value each person’s unique perspective, skills, and experiences. CIR embraces all individuals, regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, or nationality. We are steadfast in our commitment to fostering a just and inclusive world through intentional policies and actions. Your individuality enriches our collective strength, and we strive to ensure everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered.

**Position Summary**

We are looking for an AI Product Manager to lead cross-functional teams in defining the product vision, strategy, and roadmaps for our AI-powered digital products at scale. The role sits at the intersection of product strategy, applied AI, and renewable energy domain expertise, and will drive the next generation of our internal and market-facing products.

Building on the success of our existing platforms, the AI Product Manager will play a central role in advancing our shift toward agentic, AI-native solutions, translating business objectives and user needs into products that enable smarter automation, faster decision-making, and measurable productivity gains across the organization.

**Core Responsibilities**

* **Strategy & Vision:** Define product goals, multi-quarter roadmaps, and go-to-market plans for AI-powered internal tools and customer-facing products, aligned with business objectives and user needs.
* **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Partner with engineering, data science, legal, sales, and domain experts to guide products from ideation to launch through influence rather than direct authority.
* **Data-Driven Iteration:** Analyze user behavior and market trends, design experiments, and iterate rapidly based on post-launch metrics.
* **Stakeholder Alignment:** Communicate technical and strategic trade-offs to executive leadership and build consensus across departments.
* **Product Discovery & Prioritization:** Identify high-impact AI use cases across engineering, design, project development, and business teams, and translate them into clear product requirements, user stories, and a prioritized backlog.
* **AI Product Definition:** Shape requirements for agentic applications, copilots, and automations for the renewable energy sector, working with engineering to balance model performance, cost, reliability, and user experience.
* **Adoption & Enablement:** Drive adoption of launched products across the organization through onboarding, training, and user feedback loops, and track measurable productivity gains.
* **Responsible AI & Governance:** Work with engineering and legal teams to ensure products meet standards for evaluation, guardrails, data privacy, and governance.
* **Market & Innovation Insight:** Stay current with advancements in AI, agentic tooling, and the renewable energy software landscape, and translate them into actionable product opportunities for the company.

**Educational and Technical Skills**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, data science, business, or a related field; an MBA is a plus.
* Any additional credentials that reflect an ability to operate out of the box such as having background in finance, operations, strategy will be considered a plus

**Preferred Skills**

**Product Management Proficiency:**

* Proven experience as a Product Manager owning digital or AI/ML-powered products from concept through launch and scale.
* Demonstrated ability to define product vision, build multi-quarter roadmaps, and deliver go-to-market plans.
* Strong working knowledge of AI/ML and Generative AI concepts (LLMs, RAG, agents, evaluation) sufficient to make informed trade-offs with engineering teams.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams across engineering, design, legal, and sales through influence rather than direct authority.
* Proficiency in product analytics and experimentation: defining KPIs, running A/B tests, and using tools such as SQL, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Power BI.
* Experience with agile product development and tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
* Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle, APIs, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into clear product requirements and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executive leadership.

**Renewable Energy Systems:**

* Understanding of solar energy systems and their integration into existing infrastructure

**Experience**

* Prior experience building products for the renewable energy, power, or infrastructure sectors.
* Familiarity with solar PV concepts, energy modeling, GIS data, or techno-commercial analysis.
* Experience launching AI copilots, chat interfaces, or workflow automation tools for internal or enterprise users.
* Experience with B2B or enterprise SaaS products, including pricing, packaging, and go-to-market.
* Track record of using user research and post-launch metrics to drive product iteration.
* Exposure to MLOps / LLMOps concepts such as model evaluation, observability, and continuous improvement.

**Psychosocial Skills /Human Skills/Behavioural Skills**

* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take ideas and run with them from concept to conclusion.
* Technical understanding of clean energy business processes
* Exceptional verbal and writing communication skills with superiors, peers, partners, and other stakeholders.
* Excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build consensus and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment.

**Physical Demands**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The physical demands of this job require an individual to be able to work at a computer for most of the day, be able to participate in conference calls and travel to team retreats on a time-to-time basis. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Work Conditions**

The work environment is usually quiet (normal city traffic noises are common), a blend of artificial and natural light, temperate and generally supports a collaborative work environment. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

At Cleantech Industry Resources, we embrace diversity and uphold a strong dedication to establishing an all-encompassing atmosphere for both our staff and associates. Our choices in employment are free from any bias related to race, creed, nationality, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, physical limitations, veteran status, or any other legally safeguarded attributes.

Being an integral part of Cleantech Industry Resources means you can expect to be immersed in a realm of professional possibilities within a culture that nurtures teamwork, adaptability, and the embracing of all.

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

author: Hiring Manager
title: Product Manager
job_description:
We are looking for an experienced Product Manager who is passionate about building digital products which customers love. You will join a dynamic and fast-paced environment and work with cross-functional teams to design, build and roll-out products that deliver the company’s vision and strategy.
  
  
You are currently working on a flexible work arrangement and you are interested to take on more work which can be fulfilling and eventually convert into a rewarding full-time role.
  
  
Absolutely critical is your past experience in managing & understanding the engineering time taken to develop many features and then breaking that into multiple daily sprint batches. We use agile methodology and there are no sprints which last more than 2 weeks with testing time included.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
  
  

* We are looking for someone who can work across the entire product development cycle; customer research, UX discovery, hypothesis definition, wireframing, sprint planning, project management and product marketing.
* 3+ years of experience in software product management
* Creating buy-in for our product vision both internally and with key external partners
* Translating product strategy into simplistic, detailed requirements and prototypes
* Co-ordinate information received between emails, WhatsApp voice messages & calls, competitor platforms, stakeholders of all levels and so much more
* Developer’s Time Management
* Ensure Crystal Clarity in sprint tasks
* Test completed sprints
* Drive a Project Management Platform’s usage
* Traffic Light Sprints in order of business value
* Gain a deep understanding of customer experience, identify and fill product gaps and generate new ideas that grow market share, improve customer experience and drive growth
* Scope and prioritize activities based on business and customer impact
* Work closely with the engineering team to deliver quick time-to-market by optimizing resources
* Act as a product evangelist to build awareness and understanding across the business to all stakeholders, internal & external
* Represent the company by talking to customers to solicit feedback on company products and services
* Proven work experience in product management or as an associate product manager
* Well versed with agile software development methodologies
* Some technical background with understanding and/or hands-on experience in software development and web technologies
* Excellent English is very important, written and verbal communication skills
* Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to think outside the box and roll up one’s sleeves to get the job done

  
Working Hours
  

* Flexible time, remote working, 20 hrs per week minimum to be committed
